items.name: Mountain Pine Christmas Tree Taper Candles, Set of 2
items.description_en: Our tree taper candles are molded with the graceful boughs, conical shape and deep spruce green found in the stately pines of the Pacific Northwest. A customer-favorite for Christmas decorating, the pair of tree candles bring nature's beauty to your holiday dinner table or mantel display.

items.name: Aspen Red Rim Nutcracker Porcelain Dinner Plate
items.description_en: Our Aspen dinnerware dresses up for the holidays, adding a festive note of color and seasonal charm to its sophisticated and modern silhouettes. Made of durable white porcelain, the dinner plate is rimmed in a bold band of red and showcases a single nutcracker nattily attired in red and green.

items.name: Nutcracker Cheese Knives, Set of 3
items.description_en: Stylized nutcrackers shape the handles of this whimsical cheese knife set. Crafted of aluminum and finished by hand to a mirror finish, the nutcrackers top stainless steel blades. The three-piece set features a different tool for different types of cheeses: Use the forked tool for parmesan and other hard cheeses, the rounded knife for brie and other soft cheeses and the broad blade for everything in between.

items.name: 12 Days of Christmas Vase
items.description_en: The perfect blend of modern and traditional, our 12 Days of Christmas vase gives a subtle nod to the classic carol. The lyrics are etched into the clear glass in a graceful script that reads as understated ornamentation from afar—and adds a festive note up close. Add a fresh bouquet for our favorite host gift of the season.

items.name: Silver Dot 2026 Frame Christmas Tree Ornament
items.description_en: Celebrate the year gone by with our annual frame ornaments. Adorned with a 2026 charm, the beaded silver frame commemorates a milestone, new baby or pet. Filled with a favorite snapshot, the ornament also makes a sure-to-be-treasured gift topper—and after the holidays, it can be leaned on its easel back for year-round display.

items.name: Beaded Wood 2026 Frame Christmas Tree Ornament
items.description_en: Celebrate the year gone by with our annual frame ornaments. Inspired by our beloved Jenny Lind furniture collection, this ornament boasts the same intricate woodworking and timeless beaded look. A 2026 charm and festive red ribbon complete the frame's cozy charm. Fill with a favorite snapshot and hang on the Christmas tree or use as a sure-to-be-treasured gift topper.

items.name: Bardot Pine Green Recycled Cashmere Christmas Throw Blanket 70"x55"
items.description_en: The ultimate in cozy luxury, cashmere weaves an irresistibly soft throw blanket. Made of a blend of recycled cashmere and wool in pine green, the blanket reverses to a warm natural hue, getting a pop of contrast from a crisp outline of white piping. Tossed on a sofa, armchair or bed with the coordinating Bardot pillow, our exclusive throw layers on warmth and indulgence throughout the cooler months.

items.name: Joan Anderson Arctic Friends Santa 10-oz. Mug
items.description_en: Joan Anderson's charming rendition of Santa Claus stars on our snow-white mug. Laden with holiday gifts wrapped in seasonal red and green, the jolly elf sports his iconic white beard and white-trimmed red attire. The porcelain mug is the perfect size for smaller hands and makes a nice stocking stuffer. For more than 34 years, our exclusive whimsical designs by artist Joan Anderson have been collectible favorites that sell out fast.

items.name: Joan Anderson Arctic Friends Reindeer 13-oz. Mug
items.description_en: Joan Anderson's delightful reindeer stars on our snow-white mug. Hosting a red cardinal on its antlers, the deer is festively attired in a Fair Isle sweater and striped hat in seasonal red and greens. The porcelain mug features clean lines and a graceful handle for comfortable sipping. Package the mug with coffee beans, tea or hot cocoa mix for a thoughtful holiday gift. For more than 34 years, our exclusive whimsical designs by artist Joan Anderson have been collectible favorites that sell out fast.

items.name: Bodum 10-oz. Snowman Icon Double Wall Bistro Mug
items.description_en: A tiny glass snowman inserted between this mug's two layers brings a touch of whimsy to the modern bistro styling. Made of hand-blown glass, the mug has a double-walled design that insulates your beverage of choice, while giving it an intriguing floating look. Hot drinks stay warm without burning your hands, while ice-cold drinks stay cool without the hassle of condensation. Perfect for Christmas morning tea, coffee and cocoa, our exclusive mug delights throughout the winter.

items.name: Mirrored Glass Star Christmas Tree Ornament
items.description_en: Dimensional and unique, our mirrored glass star ornament reflects Christmas tree lights to create a sparkling effect. Skilled artisans construct each one by hand, framing panes of mirrored glass with slim brass borders for a festive gold and silver palette. Complete your tree's stellar look with our other gilded ornaments and one of our star tree toppers.

items.name: Jingle Bells and Red Velvet Christmas Garland
items.description_en: Our jingle bell garland festoons your mantel, tree or doorway with the sweet sounds of Christmas. The swag strings gleaming brass-finished bells on red velvet ribbon for a luxe, classic look. Our exclusive garland also makes a charming presentation woven among candles on a holiday dining table.

items.name: Zinc and Wood Holiday Nutcrackers
items.description_en: A modern take on tradition, our handcrafted nutcracker decoration stands at attention in bold silhouette. The warmth of sustainably sourced wood joins sturdy cast iron and aluminum finished in black zinc, giving the beloved Christmas icon a contemporary mixed-materials look. Pair our signature nutcracker with its taller counterpart, or create a cadre of old and new with our traditional wood nutcrackers.

items.name: Green Verdigris Holiday Reindeer Decorations
items.description_en: We've updated our bestselling reindeer with a green patina for the look of impeccably aged bronze sculptures. Cast by hand with modern, abstracted silhouettes and flowing curves in durable aluminum, the reindeer is sculpted with elongated legs and rounded cuteness that add a playful element to holiday decor. A verdigris finish gives it the unique color, subtle texture and charm of a flea market find. Due to the artisanal patina created by hand, each caribou is fascinatingly unique. Group with our other exclusive reindeer sculptures to create a miniature herd on your fireplace mantel, buffet or dining room table.

items.name: Wooden Christmas Market Holiday Advent Calendar
items.description_en: Count down to Christmas with our delightful advent calendar. Crafted of sustainably sourced wood, the reusable calendar tops a long case of mini drawers with a bustling winter market. Sparkling snow tops evergreen trees and charming shops and stalls (we especially love the bakery), while revelers ski and shop. Lights in all of the buildings cast a cozy glow—simply turn on the timer to illuminate them automatically every night throughout the month. A gorgeous decor piece to look forward to using every holiday season, our exclusive wooden Christmas market advent calendar offers 24 drawers that can be filled with treats and tiny toys.

items.name: Pre-lit LED White Textured Christmas Trees 4.5"-16"
items.description_en: Christmas charm meets modern minimalism in our illuminated trees. Skilled artisans glaze the conical ceramic conifer in snow white by hand. Cutouts in the stoneware allow the glow of the integrated warm white bulbs to shine through, creating the look of gracefully draped string lights. Simply turn on the timer for automatic tree lighting every night throughout the season. Create a wintry forest on your mantel or dining table by mixing and matching the small star-topped tree with our other exclusive holiday trees.

items.name: Wooden Snowman Holiday Decoration
items.description_en: Black dots on stacked spheres create the unmistakable shape of a snowman in our charming wood snowman decoration. Minimalist yet super fun, our exclusive snowman is handcarved of mango wood and accented with black-finished brass for the nose and buttons. Great on its own, the large snowman also pairs with its coordinating small counterpart.

items.name: Alpaca Knit Christmas Tree Animal Ornament Collection
items.description_en: Artisanal and downright delightful, our cat Christmas ornament is handknit from super-soft alpaca-blend yarn. Sporting a pine green muffler and oversized red glasses, this grey feline adds a fashion-forward sense of whimsy to your holiday tree. Part of our exclusive alpaca tree decoration collection, the cat ornament makes up a charming menagerie along with its companion animal and snowman ornaments.

items.name: Red Quilted Velvet Christmas Stocking Collection
items.description_en: Organic cotton velvet stitched with diamond quilting gives our stocking classic Christmas appeal with a touch of luxury. Finished with contrasting piping, the ruby-red stocking is irresistibly soft with a modern matte finish.

items.name: Green Glass Christmas Trees 7"-13.5"
items.description_en: Create a wintry wonderland on your mantel, buffet or dining room table with our glass tree collection. Highly skilled artisans blow green glass by hand to create this exquisite evergreen. Facets give the conical conifer texture and depth, and the verdant hue is lush and gorgeous. Pairing beautifully with our other glass, ceramic and wooden trees, this matte green version accommodates a flameless tealight for a magical glow.

items.name: Brass Finish Holiday Reindeer Decorations
items.description_en: Crafted by hand with flowing curves and a modern, abstracted silhouette, our reindeer sculpture gazes across the winter landscape. The small caribou's elongated legs and endearing personality add a playful element to holiday decor, while the gleaming brass finish brings a touch of glam. Group with our other exclusive reindeer sculptures to create a miniature holiday herd on your fireplace mantel, buffet or dining room table—we especially love the way the gilded deer reflect the sparkle of Christmas lights.

items.name: Wood Holiday Reindeer Decoration
items.description_en: Our best-selling reindeer sculptures get a new Scandinavian-inspired look. Crafted by hand with a modern, abstracted silhouette and flowing curves in pale wood, our small reindeer gazes across the winter landscape, searching for delicious moss, lichen and ferns. The caribou's elongated legs and rounded cuteness add a playful element to holiday decor. Group with other sizes of our other exclusive reindeer sculptures to create a miniature herd on your fireplace mantel, buffet or dining room table—for an extra touch of wintry wonder, sprinkle the scene with fluffy faux snow. Carved out of renewable solid mango wood, from trees no longer producing fruit, our hand-polished reindeer is topped with black aluminum antlers. By choosing FSC ®-certified furniture, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests.

items.name: Winter Wonderland Glass Christmas Tree Collection
items.description_en: Create a wintry wonderland on your mantel, buffet or dining room table with our glass tree collection. A matte winter-white coating on the interior brings the fluted contrast and molded lattice pattern of the antique silver mercury glass into wintery contrast. We love the subtle way the extra-large tree shines in the glow of candles and string lights.

items.name: Faux Cypress Real Touch Christmas Wreath and Garlands
items.description_en: Gorgeous green with lifelike detailing, this lush length of faux cypress looks lovely draped along the mantel, up the stairway or down the dining room table. Handcrafted by skilled artisans, our exclusive faux cypress garland festoons your home with the natural beauty of the winter landscape—without the sap and shedding needles. This artificial evergreen garland, a Crate and Barrel exclusive, has a bold presence with its full, feathery fronds and vibrant green hue.

items.name: Santa's Village Holiday Advent Calendar
items.description_en: Count down to Christmas with our showstopping advent calendar. Crafted of handpainted wood, the reusable calendar tops a long case of mini drawers with Santa's village. Sparkling snow tops evergreen trees, wreaths, picket fences and the roofs of houses, while reindeer stroll the picturesque streets. Lights in all of the buildings cast a cozy glow—simply turn on the timer to illuminate them automatically every night throughout the month. A colorful keepsake to look forward to using every holiday season, our exclusive advent calendar offers 24 drawers that can be filled with treats and tiny toys.

items.name: Wooden Christmas Trees
items.description_en: Create a wintry wonderland on your mantel, buffet or dining room table with our wooden tree collection. Highly skilled artisans carve each one by hand to create evergreens at once charming and elevated. Crafted of renewable solid mango wood from trees no longer producing fruit, the tree stacks tiers of graceful boughs. We love the way this elegantly rustic pine pairs with the other sleeker trees we offer to create a modern woodland.

items.name: Antique Zinc Holiday Reindeer Decoration
items.description_en: Crafted with a modern, abstracted silhouette and flowing curves, our reindeer sculpture shows off an extravagant pair of antlers. The caribou's bold stance and handpainted black zinc finish add a touch of drama to holiday decor. Group with our other exclusive reindeer to create a miniature herd on your fireplace mantel, buffet or dining room table.

items.name: Red Velvet Bows Christmas Tree Garland
items.description_en: Our velvet bow garland festoons your mantel, tree or doorway, whimsically invoking lovingly wrapped gifts. Luxurious-yet-sweet, the swag decorates a fireplace mantel, stairway or tree with classic Christmas color. Our exclusive garland also makes a charming presentation woven among candles on a holiday dining table.

items.name: Jingle Bells and Blue Velvet Christmas Garland
items.description_en: Our jingle bell garland festoons your mantel, tree or doorway with the sweet sounds of Christmas. The hand-knotted swag strings gleaming brass-finished bells on blue velvet ribbon for a luxe, wintry look. Our exclusive garland also makes a charming presentation woven among candles on a holiday dining table.

items.name: Faux Magnolia and Pinecone Pre-Lit Holiday Pine 28" Wreath and 6' Garland
items.description_en: Glossy magnolia leaves join wintry pine branches in our lifelike wreath and garland set. Unparalleled in quality and skillfully crafted to look just like the real thing, the leafy decorations incorporate real pine cones for an especially naturalistic look. Velvety green ribbons add a festive touch. The battery-powered pre-lit wreath and garland with timers twinkle with warm white lights.

items.name: Faux Hemlock Pine Pre-Lit LED Real Touch Wreath and Garland
items.description_en: Lush and evergreen, our faux pre-lit hemlock instantly updates your front door or mantel with holiday cheer. Studded with starry warm white LED lights, the fool-the-eye wreath brilliantly recreates the hemlock's dark green color and lacy boughs. Switch on the battery-powered wreath or use the timer and watch it twinkle throughout the night. Unparalleled in quality and skillfully crafted to look just like the real thing, our exclusive pre-lit wreath enlivens your home with the look of fresh evergreens for years to come.

items.name: Sugared Fruit Glass Christmas Tree Ornaments
items.description_en: Fruit-shaped ornaments hint at the extravagant bounty of the Christmas feast, adorning the tree with delicious color and shine. Naturalistically modeled with green leaves and textured yellow skin, our lemon gets its sparkle from an all-over application of glitter. Add our other fruit-shaped ornaments for a tree that celebrates seasonal delights.

items.name: Red Wood Bird Christmas Tree Ornament Clip
items.description_en: Our ruby-red bird Christmas tree ornament brings the natural beauty of winter to your Christmas tree. Carved with simplified curves and streamlined style, the red wood Christmas tree ornament perches comfortably among the evergreen boughs thanks to its metal clip. Our wood bird Christmas tree ornament clip is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Large Faux Red Mini Berry Holiday Wreath 32"
items.description_en: Countless ruby-like red berries animate our faux wreath with vibrant color and energy. Just as the petite berries provide an unexpected pop of color in the snowy winter landscape, our lifelike wreath invigorates your seasonal decor hung on an inside door or above a fireplace mantel. Our artificial red berry wreath is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Faux Pre-Lit Norfolk Pine Holiday 28" Wreath and 6' Garland
items.description_en: Our pre-lit garland graces the home with the expressive tiered branches and needle-like leaves of the Norfolk pine, skillfully crafted to look just like the real thing. The faux botanical comes pre-lit with warm white LED lights and bendable branches that can be adjusted to further enhance the evergreen's lifelike appearance.

items.name: Arctic Friends Penguin Wool Christmas Stocking by Joan Anderson
items.description_en: A sweet penguin poses amidst a flurry of snowflakes on our cranberry-red stocking, all dressed up for the holiday season. We love the way the green-striped top hat adds a festive detail to the adorably modern and minimalist illustration by Joan Anderson. Finished with a snow-white cuff perfect for personalizing, the wool-blend Christmas stocking coordinates with the rest of our Arctic Friend holiday collection. For 32 years, our exclusive whimsical designs by artist Joan Anderson have been collectible favorites that sell out fast.

items.name: European Frosty Winter Scene Glass Christmas Tree Ornament
items.description_en: This painterly ornament brings the serene wonder of the winter landscape indoors. Talented artisans craft each one by hand, blowing glass into a sphere and adorning it with a peaceful, frosty scene. Painted in a subtle palette of whites and greens, a dapper snowman stands proudly amid snow drifts and frosted trees. A gleaming gold cap and snow-white ribbon complete our exclusive Christmas tree ornament.

items.name: Joan Anderson's Arctic Friend Reindeer 20"x20" Spruce Green Throw Pillow
items.description_en: Joan Anderson's whimsical holiday critters make an encore appearance on our festive throw pillows. Appliqued in white on a backdrop of spruce green, an antlered reindeer greets the season with a nose and scarf embroidered in red. The felted wood-blend pillow is accented with a flurry of white embroidered stars and finished with black piping. Fill the square Arctic Friend pillow cover with a plush feather-down or lofty down-alternative insert (sold separately). For more than 30 years, our exclusive whimsical designs by artist Joan Anderson have been collectible favorites that sell out fast.

items.name: Red Velvet Holiday Wreath Bow
items.description_en: Our bow instantly dresses up fresh, dried and faux wreaths in festive fashion. Luxe velvet ribbon ties a generous bow, and the rich red hue looks festive and welcoming throughout the winter. Monogrammable for a sweet personal touch, the bow has matching ties that make it easy to attach to your favorite wreath (sold separately),

items.name: Icicle Christmas Tree Pick, Set of 4
items.description_en: Our tree pick ornament makes it so easy to spike the Christmas tree with icy sparkles. Needing neither a hanger nor string, this spray of clear, faceted gems nestles effortlessly into tree boughs. Use as a shimmering accent or lavish the tree with multiple picks for a frozen forest look. Not just for Christmas trees, the icicle pick adds instant interest stuck in a wreath, faux floral arrangement or festive tablescape.

items.name: Capiz Snowflake Christmas Tree Ornament
items.description_en: Our capiz snowflake ornament brings a touch of the tropics to your winter decor. The windowpane oyster shells set into the metal framework bring subtle luminosity to the Christmas tree, shimmering in the glow of string lights. Hand-constructed by skilled artisans, the dimensional snowflake solders together capiz diamonds with brass for an ornament with lustrous elegance.

items.name: Textured Metallic Glass Ball Christmas Ornaments, Boxed Set of 6
items.description_en: Bring depth and subtle sheen to your Christmas tree with our textured ball Christmas tree ornaments in chic shades of gold, silver and grey. A mixture of gleaming and matte textured balls topped with golden caps, the set of six hand-blown glass Christmas tree ornaments dresses your tree with modern sophistication.

items.name: Faux Cream Lunaria Wreath 32"
items.description_en: The neutral palette of our faux lunaria wreath suits all seasons. Often called "silver dollar plant," lunaria gets its nickname from the way its seed pods resemble shimmering coins. Our exclusive wreath recreates the look in a flurry of delicate circles of cream anchored on slender stems. The wreath graces an interior door, fireplace or dining table with a wild, naturalistic beauty tempered by its muted hues. Our artificial silver dollar wreath is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Marble Snowman Taper Candle Holders
items.description_en: Ultra-modern yet oh-so-whimsical, our snowman taper holder delights throughout the winter. Luxe white marble shapes our snowy friend's iconic silhouette, topped with a high-shine chrome top hat that accommodates a candle. Scatter a few large and small candlesticks down your dining table or across your mantel to create a playful scene with wintry elegance.

items.name: Winter Scene Christmas Ornament
items.description_en: Every time you peek at our winter scene Christmas ball ornament, you'll discover a different handpainted vignette. From skiers to sledders to pups living their best winter life, each one captures the essence of a snowy holiday. Our favorite element of this Crate & Barrel exclusive is the unique decorative car carrying home a freshly cut Christmas tree perched at the top, replacing the usual hook.

items.name: Gold Glass Chip Christmas Tree Pick
items.description_en: Add a shower of sparkles to your holiday decor with our exclusive gold pick Christmas tree ornament. Handcrafted by highly skilled artisans, the delicate spray features metal flecks, beads and sequins that shine like glass, reflecting the light from candles and string lights. Stick a pick in a flower arrangement, amongst a wintry tablescape or in your Christmas tree to instantly create festive glamour.

items.name: Faux White Ilex Berry Christmas Garland 6'
items.description_en: Creamy white berries, hand painted for added realism, cluster to form a six-foot garland that's ready to grace the table, mantel or doorframe with winter finery.

items.name: Faux Cypress Real Touch Christmas Tree Stem 30"
items.description_en: Gorgeous green with lifelike detailing, this faux stem of cypress looks lovely arranged in a centerpiece or incorporated into a holiday floral arrangement. Or create a more modern and minimalist winter look by placing a single cypress stem in a tall clear or black vase. Handcrafted by skilled artisans, our exclusive artificial stem brings the natural beauty of the winter landscape indoors—without the sap and shedding needles.

items.name: Faux Cypress and Red Berry Holiday Wreath 30"
items.description_en: Our faux wreath masterfully recreates the deep green color and feathery look of cypress. Dotted with small red berries, the lifelike evergreen ring is accented with a deep red ribbon.

items.name: Elegant Cut Glass Christmas Trees 11.5"-13.5"
items.description_en: Create a wintry wonderland on your mantel, buffet or dining room table with our glass tree collection. Highly skilled artisans blow and etch clear glass by hand to create this exquisite evergreen. A faceted grid patterns the conical conifer with crisp geometry and just the right amount of sparkle. Pairing beautifully with our other glass, ceramic and wooden trees, this elegant version suits modern and traditional holiday decor equally well.

items.name: Steinbach Handmade German Christmas Nutcracker Collection
items.description_en: Carved and decorated by hand, our exclusive nutcracker serves up a perfectly brewed pot of tea and a sweet treat. The spectacularly mustachioed gentleman welcomes you to a cozy tearoom in the Cotswolds, sporting a handsewn candy cane-triped apron with a tiered dessert server at his feet. This heirloom-quality—and functional—nutcracker is handcrafted by the exceptionally skilled artisans of the Christian Ulbricht toy factory in Seiffen, Germany, which was founded in 1928.

items.name: Faux Cypress and Red Berry Holiday Garland 6'
items.description_en: Our faux garland masterfully recreates the deep green color and feathery look of cypress. Dotted with small red berries, the lifelike evergreen drapes mantels, door frames and bannisters with wintery elegance

items.name: European Red Poinsettia Ball Christmas Tree Ornament
items.description_en: Our botanical ball ornaments dress your Christmas tree with exquisite artisanship. Hand-blown by talented craftspeople, the glass sphere is painted by hand with vibrant ruby red poinsettias and emerald foliage on sapphire blue. Glitter details sparkle in the glow of string lights. This gorgeous ornament is perfect for a formal tree with Old World glamour.

items.name: European Red Chrysanthemum Christmas Tree Ornament
items.description_en: Our chrysanthemum Christmas ornament dresses your tree with exquisite artisanship. Hand-blown by talented craftspeople, the glass sphere is painted by hand with lavish ruby red blooms and emerald green foliage on snow-white. Glitter details sparkle in the glow of string lights. This gorgeous ornament is perfect for a formal tree with Old World glamour.

items.name: Large Faux White Mini Berry Holiday Wreath 32"
items.description_en: Countless creamy berries cluster to form a richly textured wintry wreath, animated with sprightly lifelike twigs. Bringing the beauty of the winter landscape indoors, our faux white berry wreath invigorates your seasonal decor hung on an inside door or above a fireplace mantel. Our artificial white berry wreath is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Faux Pre-Lit Hemlock & Berry Garland 6'
items.description_en: Our pre-lit garland graces the home with the lifelike greenery. Skillfully crafted to look just like real botanicals, the lush swag replicates the soft, feathery appearance of hemlock boughs accented with clusters of red berries. Lit with warm white LED lights, the battery-operated garland looks lovely on a mantel, draped on a banister or running the length of a dining room table.

items.name: Cranberry Decorative Bowl Filler
items.description_en: Bring a pop of seasonal color to a centerpiece bowl or hurricane with our cranberry bowl filler. Delightfully realistic, the bright red berries are packaged in a clear plastic bag and tied with twine, making them a great grab-and-go host gift.

items.name: Faux Juniper, Pinecone and Acorn Holiday Garland and Wreath Collection
items.description_en: A mix of faux pine boughs and acorns fashion this lush wreath. Unparalleled in quality and skillfully crafted to look just like the real thing, the wreath incorporates real pine cones for an especially naturalistic look. A velvety brown ribbon adds a festive touch.

items.name: Felted Wool Mouse with Green Cardigan Christmas Tree Ornament
items.description_en: Bundled up for winter, our felted animal wool ornaments add old-fashioned sweetness and charm to the Christmas tree. This dapper mouse is ready for a holiday party or Nutcracker matinee, all dressed up in a chunky turtleneck, jaunty cap and green sweater with gleaming gold buttons. A fashion-forward presence on your tree, our exclusive mouse ornament also makes a sweet and snuggly gift topper.

items.name: Faux Norfolk Pine Mini Holiday Wreath 14"
items.description_en: Grace your holiday home with the expressive needle-like leaves of the Norfolk pine masterfully replicated in this lush wreath. Hung above a mantel or entryway wall, the festive wreath refreshes your seasonal decor with lifelike greenery.

items.name: Faux Red Mini Berry Wreath 14"
items.description_en: Countless ruby-like red berries animate our faux mini wreath with vibrant color and energy. Just as the petite berries provide an unexpected pop of color in the snowy winter landscape, the lifelike wreath invigorates your seasonal decor hung on an inside door or above a fireplace mantel. Our small artificial red berry wreath is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Monochrome No. 03 Evergreen Scented Candles and Diffuser - Eucalyptus, Balsam and Winterberry
items.description_en: Utterly modern in monochromatic green. Our Evergreen candle infuses the air with the invigorating scents of eucalyptus, spearmint, fir balsam and winter citrus. Packaged in a green gift box, the matte green glass vessel filled with green wax has a sculptural look that brightens your coffee table, dresser or mantel. Part of our exclusive Monochrome scent collection, the No. 03 Evergreen candle is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: White Pillar Candles
items.description_en: This classic pillar candle is exactly the right size for most of our pillar holders and fits in many hurricanes, lanterns and other candle holders. Unscented wax in pristine white makes it perfect for the modern dining table.

items.name: Monochrome No. 8 Harvest Scented Candles - Pumpkin, Cinnamon, Vanilla
items.description_en: Utterly modern in monochromatic orange. Our Harvest candle infuses the air with the sweetness of caramel, brown sugar, pumpkin and vanilla and the spicy coziness of nutmeg and cinnamon. Packaged in burnt orange gift boxes, the matching glass vessels filled with orange wax has a clean, crisp look that brightens your coffee table, dresser or mantel. Part of our exclusive Monochrome scent collection, the No. 8 Harvest candle evokes autumnal baking and pumpkin spice.

items.name: Geranium + Bergamot Candle
items.description_en: Fill your kitchen with the spicy floral fragrances of geranium and bergamot. Our exclusive candle provides a fresh, clean aroma of jasmine, geranium leaf, star anise, parsley and peach against a backdrop of zesty citrus. Echoing the enticing smells of baking and cooking, our kitchen scent collection features plant-based formulas with deliciously fragrant combinations of essential oils. The white glass vessel looks crisp and modern on the counter. View all "The Kitchen by Crate" collection

items.name: Wilmette Citronella Candles with Wooden Stand
items.description_en: Elevate a summertime essential with our mid-century modern citronella candle. The three-wick candle housed in a white ceramic container wafts the fresh, citrusy scent as you dine, sip or lounge outside. A solid wood stand creates mixed-material appeal while giving the candle a little lift. Once the candle has burned away, the ceramic and wood duo can be used as a cachepot.

items.name: Monochrome No. 12 Amethyst Scent Collection - Black Plum, Lavender and Eucalyptus
items.description_en: Utterly modern in monochromatic purple. Our Amethyst candle infuses the air with the sweetness of plum and lilac plus the invigorating scents of eucalyptus and lavender, grounded by cedarwood and amber. Packaged in a dusky purple gift box, the matching matte glass vessel filled with wax in the same hue has a sculptural look that warms your coffee table, dresser or mantel. Part of our exclusive Monochrome scent collection, the No. 12 Amethyst Purple candle is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Monochrome No. 02 Onyx Scent Collection - Vetiver, Cedarwood and Musk
items.description_en: Utterly modern in monochromatic black. Our Onyx candle infuses the air with the invigorating scents of cypress, eucalyptus and thyme grounded by the richness of rose, myrrh and sandalwood. Packaged in a black gift box, the matte black glass vessel filled with black wax has a bold look that adds a touch of drama to your coffee table, dresser or mantel. Part of our exclusive Monochrome scent collection, the No. 02 Onyx candle is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Warm White Flameless Wax Candles
items.description_en: Made of real wax, our flameless candle fools the eye with lifelike flickering and the warm glow of a lit flame. The white pillar candle is safe and mess-free, providing atmosphere and gentle illumination on the nightstand, next to the bathtub or anywhere a burning candle would be impractical. items.description_en: Space-saving and fun to use, our Bristol three-tier server is great for festive dinners or brunch buffets. Made of black-finished iron, the clean-lined stand hosts three round white ceramic serving plates for a multilevel presentation of cupcakes, fruit or hors d'oeuvres. The stand's support forms an arched handle that makes it easy to transport the server from kitchen to table. Pair with other pieces in the Bristol serving collection for coordinated entertaining.

items.name: Tuscan Kitchen Marble Wine Cooler
items.description_en: Keep wine perfectly chilled at the table in this column of speckled beige marble with subtle white and grey veining and plenty of organic warmth. The insulating properties of marble help your favorite bottles stay at optimal temperatures as you eat, chat and sip. Due to the natural material, each of our exclusive beige marble wine coolers is beautifully unique.

items.name: Deep Square Sauce Dish
items.description_en: Deep, angled dish is handcrafted of white porcelain and sized to perfectly accommodate sauces, dips and condiments. The square 4-ounce bowl, a Crate and Barrel exclusive, is a petite essential. Place one at each guest's place to hold sweet or savory sauces for potstickers, grilled meats, fresh fruit and shortbread cookies.

items.name: Farmhouse Soup Bowl
items.description_en: Alone or paired up with the matching sandwich plate, this charming white soup bowl is ribbed with the look of hand-thrown pottery. Crafted by skilled artisans in Portugal, the bowl is part of our classic Farmhouse collection distinguished by its bold rims and sturdy feel.

items.name: Marin Sage Green Small Stoneware Serving Bowl
items.description_en: Artisans finish each piece of our bestselling Marin dinnerware by hand. This serving bowl's sage green reactive glaze showcases rich tonal color and natural variations that make each one unique. A light tan rim highlights the organic contours while adding a kiss of contrast.

items.name: Dune 22-Piece Flatware & Serveware Set
items.description_en: This sculptural flatware features an implied hourglass shape with a beautiful brushed finish. Hefty yet comfy, the well-thought-out proportions are suitable for every day and entertaining. Handles feel molded to the hand. Available in our exclusive 22-piece set. Four 5-piece place settings include salad fork, dinner fork, knife, dinner spoon and teaspoon, plus a serving fork and serving spoon.

items.name: Splatter Enamelware Navy and Cream Oval Platter
items.description_en: An exuberant take on traditional speckleware, Splatter dapples white dinnerwares with spatters of blue. Each lightweight and durable piece is made of steel fused with layers of porcelain enamel. Combine the oval platter with other Splatter dinnerware to set an eye-catching table that looks rustic yet modern.

items.name: Parlour Wood & Metal Round Bar Tray
items.description_en: Our Parlour tray instantly infuses your home bar—or bar cart—with cozy, clubby style. Stained a deep walnut hue, a round of sustainably sourced acacia wood shows off its gorgeous grain. The polished stainless steel rim completes the midcentury look with a bit of space-age sleekness. Use the engravable tray to display prized bottles, serve mixed drinks to guests or tote a cocktail and snacks to the sofa.

items.name: Le Creuset ® White Chip & Dip with 24-oz. Mini Cocotte 2-Piece Set
items.description_en: Elevate your appetizer offerings with this versatile set from Le Creuset . Made of durable stoneware glazed crisp white, the serving duo comprises a chip and dip bowl and a mini cocotte. The platter's all-in-one design integrates an outer bowl for crackers and chips and a dip bowl at the center that also can cradle the mini cocotte with lid.

items.name: Marin Holly Berry Oval Platter
items.description_en: Our bestselling Marin platter dresses up for the holidays with delightful holly sprigs. Handpainted with a watercolor effect, the off-set botanical design is the perfect accent to the serving plate's freeform curves. Layer with other Marin pieces in white or pine green for a lovely presentation.

items.name: Madeira 12" Walnut-Finished Acacia Wood Salad Serving Bowl
items.description_en: Designed for casual gatherings, our Madeira serving bowl makes a relaxed presentation of gorgeous salads and more. The wide, shallow silhouette looks modern and generous while ensuring toppings don't sink to the bottom. Hand-finished by skilled artisans in a warm walnut hue, the sustainably sourced acacia wood has an organic warmth we love on grazing tables and effortlessly chic dining tables. The small size suits snacks or individual salads, the medium is perfect for a family and the large serves a crowd. Elevated upon a subtle foot, each gorgeously grained bowl is one of a kind.

items.name: Wood and Marble Footed Fruit Bowl
items.description_en: A masterwork of natural materials, our white marble and mango wood footed pedestal makes a still-life display of fresh fruits. Crafted of renewable solid mango wood, from trees no longer producing fruit, the fruit bowl also provides an elegant, elevated presentation of cheese puffs, cookies, pretzels and other treats. For unified entertaining, add our other wood and marble serving pieces. By choosing FSC ®-certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests.

items.name: Carson 9" Acacia Wood Salad Serving Bowl
items.description_en: Skilled woodworkers in India fashion select planks of acacia wood with varying color and grain before fashioning them into this beautifully grained bowl. By choosing FSC®-certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests.

items.name: Mercer White Porcelain 5" Mini Bowl
items.description_en: Contemporary porcelain whiteware represents a fusion of refinement and rusticity. The round slim profile of this mini bowl takes on organic overtones with freeform rims and a finely "hammered" surface that ripples the light. Smooth enough to not harm tables, the unglazed ceramic bottom surface gives each piece an artisanal look.

items.name: Oven-to-Table Sheet Pan with Acacia Wood Trivet
items.description_en: True to its name, this serving set nestles a white ceramic sheet pan on an acacia trivet. Elegant in its simplicity and mix of materials, the combination keeps straight-from-the-oven sheet pan dinners warm while tidying buffet tables and counters. Our sheet pan with wood trivet is a Crate & Barrel exclusive. By choosing FSC®-certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests.

items.name: Kenton Matte Flatware Sets
items.description_en: Streamlined modern stainless steel flatware features an eye-catching dual finish that contrasts frosted matte handles with mirror-polished heads and blades. Each five-piece place setting includes a salad fork, dinner fork, knife, spoon and teaspoon. For a unified table, pair with our Kenton serving set or any of our stainless steel serving utensils. items.name: Oxford Mirror Flatware Sets
items.description_en: Our Oxford flatware sets the table with classic shapes and subtle accents. Well balanced in the hand, the cutlery feature graciously sized heads and slim handles with rounded ends and banded detailing at the top and bottom. The stainless steel flatware complements dinnerware with a gleaming mirror finish. The place setting comprises salad fork, fork, knife, soup spoon and teaspoon.

items.name: Caesna Mirror Flatware Sets
items.description_en: Designed by Robert Welch Designs in the English Cotswolds, this classically styled pattern with well-balanced, comfortable heft and a beautiful, bright mirror finish is a much-anticipated addition to our Caesna collection of individual specialty serving pieces.

items.name: Boulder Mirror Flatware Sets
items.description_en: A blending of generations brings a contemporary new shape to the classic hammered finish. Stainless steel flatware with stylish heads and round hammered handles is polished to a mirror finish.

items.name: Uptown Mirror Flatware Sets
items.description_en: A pleasure to hold, Uptown's pencil-thin handles taper to a dramatic point. Continuous sweep of the coordinating knife throws in a contemporary curve.

items.name: Emerge Mirror Flatware Sets
items.description_en: Lean and clean for contemporary tables. This quality forged flatware pattern is slim-lined yet substantial in heft. Reflective mirror finish adds sparkle to place settings.

items.name: Tuscany Mirror Flatware Sets

items.name: Scoop Mirror Flatware Sets
items.description_en: Appealing contours, subtly "scooped" handles and a sparkling mirror finish are suited to casual or formal dining. items.name: Aspen Mirror Dinner Forks, Set of 4
items.description_en: Great add-ons for entertaining, in sets of four at a great value. The set of dinner forks, a Crate and Barrel exclusive, gleams with a polished finish. Sleek stainless steel is dishwasher-safe for quick and easy cleanup after everyday meals and dinner parties.

items.name: Caesna Texture Flatware Sets

The five-piece stainless steel flatware set is well-balanced with a comfortable heft. A pleasure to hold and behold, this versatile, classically styled pattern designed by Robert Welch elevates any table setting.

Each of the eight 5-piece place settings consists of a dinner fork, salad fork, dinner spoon, teaspoon and dinner knife. items.description_en: Inspired by well-loved bistro flatware, this five-piece place setting brings French cafe style to your table. items.name: 18th Street 14-oz. Mug
items.description_en: Modern and restrained in form, expressive and rustic in glaze. A contemporary matte black exterior contrasts the rustic beauty of a shiny, speckled white glazed interior ringed with the subtly raised spiral associated with hand-thrown pieces. A raised clay rim features a sandy glaze that evokes the feel of exposed terra cotta. To capture the artisan look of this dinnerware, Erteman modeled prototypes to true scale by hand with her original glazes as reference for production. In the words of the designer, "When making tableware, I consider design and the rigors of daily use. The spirit of my hand in these pieces is modest, to harmonize with and act as a support to the prepared ingredients."

items.name: Alma 13.5-oz. Clear Glass Mug
items.description_en: Inspired by Parisian flea market finds, the Alma mug brings fascinating texture to hot coffee or tea. items.name: Ora 12-oz. Stoneware Mug

items.name: Aspen 15-oz. Porcelain White Mug
items.description_en: Crisp white oversized shape in durable porcelain goes casual for everyday, or sophisticated for formal dinners.

items.name: Kiln 11-oz. Off-White Mug by Leanne Ford
items.description_en: Inspired by the "wonky wobbly" (her words) pieces that Leanne Ford creates in her Pittsburgh ceramic studio, this mug brings the designer's effortless cool to an artisanal dinnerware collection. Our hit collaboration with designer Leanne Ford continues with the exclusive Origins Collection, introducing fresh designs for the whole home. From layered neutrals to dreamy curves to a little rock-and-roll edge, it's everything that makes the designer a star.

items.name: Berkshire 12-oz. Stackable Mugs, Set of 4

From initial sketches to rigorous testing, every expertly designed product in this kitchen collection meets our standards, and yours.

To keep things orderly inside kitchen cabinets, the set includes two organizers that corral all of the components.

items.name: Marin Mirror 5-Piece Serving Set
items.description_en: Simple and striking, these sculptural serving pieces are compatible with a wide variety of dinnerware. Serve up appetizers, salads, dinner and desserts with our stainless steel serving fork, spoon, pierced spoon, pie server and butter knife. A Crate and Barrel exclusive, the set is dimensional, well-balanced and comfortable with a smooth, bright mirror finish.

items.name: Grand Hotel II 5-Piece Serving Set
items.description_en: In the gracious tradition of our Grand Hotel flatware, this new version is scaled up and even more substantial in weight. Classically designed, the serving pieces feature intricate beadwork accentuated with a subtle dome in the center of the handles.

items.name: Stainless Steel Chopsticks
items.description_en: Chopsticks go sleek and modern in mirror-finished stainless steel. Round with hollow construction, the chopsticks feature notched detailing to help keep a grip on food and provide a sturdy hold.

items.name: Kohler Sink Utility Rack
items.description_en: Organize your sink and improve workflow with this handy utility rack. Utility rack keeps cleaning tools accessible, and soaking cup holds to-be-washed utensils. A dishcloth rail aids in drying. The rack expands three inches to fit most sinks and features a recessed design that keeps the rack below counter level and out of sight. View all Kohler products

items.name: YouCopia UpSpace Bottle Organizer, 9 Bottle
items.description_en: This ingenious organizer makes the most of your available storage space, neatly holding up to nine tumblers, sports bottles, travel mugs and other bottles so they're easy to grab and go. Supported by a strong reinforced steel frame, the three speckled white shelves are textured to prevent bottles from rolling around. Adjust the shelves to suit your collection and keep your pantry or cabinets orderly and accessible.

items.name: Holly Leaf Ceramic Ramekins, Set of 2
items.description_en: Our holly ramekins instantly add festive flair to whatever you're serving at wintry cocktail parties and Christmas feasts. Adorned with ruby red berries, the deep green leaf-shaped pair presents nuts and olives, a selection of chocolates, or crostini and just-baked cheese dip. Skilled artisans glaze and paint each petite porcelain baker by hand. The ramekins make for charming gifts, especially filled with our signature holiday candies.

items.name: Remi Natural Linen Table Lamp 31.7"
items.description_en: Remi wraps a table lamp entirely in ivory linen with gilded accents. Topped with a steeply pitched matching shade, the columnar base shows off the slubbed fabric and the warm burnished brass accents. Adding texture and softness next to a sofa or armchair, our Remi linen table lamp is a Crate and Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Amaryllis Small Black Ceramic Table Lamp 24.5"
items.description_en: Recalling the slope-shouldered silhouette of a Chinese plum vase, our Amaryllis table lamp lights up the room with the nuanced beauty of fine ceramics. A matte black glaze coats the wide, concave facets of the ceramic base with a distressed, stone-like finish that's echoed in the texture of the neutral linen-blend shade. We love the play of light on the sculptural base of our exclusive Amaryllis small ceramic table lamp.

items.name: Formosa Stone Table Lamp 8"
items.description_en: Lighting as art. A burnished brass shade floats over Formosa's handmade marble base to create an energetic, asymmetrical table lamp. Tilted dynamically, the gleaming metal shade contrasts beautifully with the organic swirls of grey, white and black that animate the stone sphere. Our Formosa stone table lamp is a Crate and Barrel exclusive. Due to the natural material, each one is unique.

items.name: Weston Black Mid-Century Modern Table Lamp 27"
items.description_en: Inspired by mid-century modern design, our Weston table lamp captures the design movement's impeccable pairing of clean lines and organic materials. Turned solid walnut tops the conical ceramic base, echoing its flared silhouette and bringing warmth to the matte black glaze. Topped with a creamy linen drum shade, Weston feels right at home on a credenza, side table or dresser.

items.name: Toro Square Weave Table Lamp 17.2"
items.description_en: Classic Japanese lanterns inspired our Toro table lamp. Clad in oak veneer with a rye finish, the cross base intersects two wood panels. Nesting within that frame is a natural linen shade that filters light softly. Constructed with a slight arc on all sides, the shade's subtle curves contrast with the linear base. Our exclusive square weave table lamp is at home in any spot in the home that could use a warm glow.

items.name: Amaryllis Small White Ceramic Table Lamp 24.5"
items.description_en: Recalling the slope-shouldered silhouette of a Chinese plum vase, our Amaryllis table lamp lights up the room with the nuanced beauty of fine ceramics. An ivory glaze coats the wide, concave facets of the ceramic base with a distressed, stone-like finish that's echoed in the texture of the linen. We love the play of light on the sculptural base of our exclusive Amaryllis small ceramic table lamp.

items.name: Amaryllis White Ceramic Mini Table Lamp 15"
items.description_en: Recalling the slope-shouldered silhouette of a Chinese plum vase, our Amaryllis table lamp lights up the room with the nuanced beauty of fine ceramics. An ivory glaze coats the wide, concave facets of the ceramic base with a distressed, stone-like finish that's echoed in the texture of the white linen shade. We love the play of light on the sculptural base of our exclusive Amaryllis small ceramic table lamp.

items.name: Allegra Rattan and Linen Dome Table Lamp by Jake Arnold 20.7"
items.description_en: Jake Arnold designed this table lamp to add soft illumination to a space. Stretched over the graceful flared dome frame, linen-blend fabric filters light softly. Burnished brass-finished metal accents and the rattan-wrapped stem play with materiality while enhancing the lamp's warm, organic presence. We love Allegra on a dresser or nightstand where it can provide the perfect bedside glow. Jake Arnold, interior designer and co-founder of The Expert, has a fresh talent for mixing insider-worthy details and real-life comfort that's made him one to watch. With this new collaboration, we're bringing the star designer's high-style look to every room of your home.

items.name: Stafford Lichen Ceramic Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 18"
items.description_en: Reactive glaze warms a classic table lamp, elevating it with the cozy sophistication of handcrafted ceramics. Earthenware shapes Stafford's boldly curved silhouette, animated by olive green glaze streaked and speckled with earthy hues. A linen taper shade provides crisp contrast, keeping focus on Stafford's heritage charm and unique finish.

items.name: Stafford Bordeaux Ceramic Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 24"
items.description_en: Reactive glaze warms a classic table lamp, elevating it with the cozy sophistication of handcrafted ceramics. Earthenware shapes Stafford's boldly curved silhouette, animated by a subtly streaked, high-gloss glaze in deep Bordeaux red. A linen taper shade provides crisp contrast, keeping focus on Stafford's heritage charm and unique finish.

items.name: Vale Ivory Fabric Table Lamp with Linen Shade 24"
items.description_en: Our Vale table lamp celebrates the timeless beauty of linen. Warmly hued and subtly slubbed, natural linen wraps the simple columnar base and forms the tightly pleated drum shade. Details finished in gleaming burnished brass complete the soft-yet-well-tailored lamp that's particularly well suited to reading nooks and bedside tables.

items.name: Clem Light Green Metal Table Lamp 19.68"
items.description_en: Our charming Clem lamp brightens your nightstand, side table or desk with a subtle pop of color. Anchored by a slender stem of solid walnut, a steel dome shade finished in dark olive green lacquer echoes the curve of the matching base. A chrome disk complements the tapered walnut finial. We love the cozy light this table lamp casts and the retro style it brings to living rooms, bedrooms and home offices.

items.name: Cadre Brass Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 20.5"
items.description_en: Stately and monolithic, our Cadre table lamp has an undeniable-yet-understated presence. Durable iron with a burnished brass finish that gleams warmly sculpts the linear base. Filtering light beautifully, the natural linen shade echoes the clean-lined geometry. We especially love the contemporary Cadre lamp in pairs on an entryway console, dining room buffet or pair of nightstands.

items.name: Vienna Metal Table Lamp with Rippled Glass Shade 17"
items.description_en: Textural and linear, our petite Vienna table lamp is a piece of jewelry for your mantel, bookshelf or nightstand. A fluted column finished in burnished brass rises from a stepped base, evoking both classical columns and industrial knurling. Hand-blown by talented artisans, the rippled glass shade creates a fascinating play of light while echoing the stem's ribbing. Vienna instantly adds a touch of warm glamour wherever you place it.

items.name: Promenade Small Brass Table Lamp with USB Port 27.75"
items.description_en: Clear glass and metal mix materials for an illuminating lamp that looks modern and timeless. Hand-blown glass cylinder lightens the look of the clean-lined table lamp accented with a cap, stepped base and tube made of brass-finished iron. Designed for modern living, each lamp also features a handy USB port on the base to keep devices charged and ready.

items.name: Seguin Brushed Brass Metal Table Lamp 24.5"
items.description_en: Rising from a sculptural tulip base, this graceful table lamp expands our Seguin lighting collection. A burnished brass contrasts warmly with the crisp white linen shade for a graphic overall look that's an instant classic. Slim and refined, this table lamp fits perfectly on a nightstand or side table.

items.name: Zain Table Lamp with USB Port 18"
items.description_en: Inspired by the Prairie style of architecture and decor, our Zain table lamp with USB port shapes perfectly balanced lines and curves, horizontals and verticals in gleaming brass. The lamp casts a lovely glow on the steel lamp's antique brass finish. Featuring a USB port in the bases for convenient charging, our Zain table lamp is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Remi Navy Blue Linen Table Lamp 31.7"
items.description_en: Remi wraps a table lamp entirely in deep blue linen-blend with gilded accents. Topped with a steeply pitched matching shade, the columnar base shows off the slubbed fabric and the warm burnished brass accents. items.name: Remi Ivory Linen Mini Table Lamp 15"
items.description_en: Remi wraps a table lamp entirely in ivory linen with gilded accents. Topped with a steeply pitched matching shade, the columnar base shows off the slubbed fabric and the warm burnished brass accents. Adding texture and softness to a bookcase or desk, our small Remi table lamp is also perfectly proportioned for a nightstand.

items.name: Tres Table Lamp
items.description_en: Sculptural yet playful, our Tres table lamp is a true delight. Finished in deep, glossy burgundy, the tubular base bends and intersects in a fascinating fashion. Each of the legs supports an orb of hand-blown opal white glass. Bubbly, bright and unexpected, Tres is just as appealing when it's off as when it's illuminated (thought we do love its soft, floating glow).

items.name: Promenade Small Black Metal Table Lamp with USB Port 27.75"
items.description_en: Clear glass and metal mix materials for an illuminating lamp that looks modern and timeless. Hand-blown glass cylinder lightens the look of the clean-lined table lamp accented with a cap, stepped base and tube made of black-finished iron. Designed for modern living, each lamp also features a handy USB port on the base to keep devices charged and ready.

items.name: Colette Hammered Brass Mini Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 13"
items.description_en: A captivating blend of artistry and function, our Colette table lamp captivates with its graceful form and exquisite materials. The organic base highlights its hammered texture with an ultra-polished brass finish. Balancing that striking sculptural design, the gathered linen shade gently diffuses light that reflects off the gleaming base to create a warm, inviting glow. Colette is perfectly proportioned for a bedside table, bookshelf or desk, adding a touch of understated elegance wherever you place it.

items.name: Solenne Metal Table Lamp with Pleated Fabric Shade 25.5"
items.description_en: Our Solenne table lamp epitomizes cozy sophistication. Gleaming with a burnished brass finish, the slender base evokes antique candlestick lamps. A classic cotton taper shade tailored with generous gathers enhances the look with countryside charm. For instant warmth and versatile illumination, scatter a few of these pleated table lamps throughout your space.

items.name: Cardiff Brass Table Lamp 16.5"
items.description_en: Balancing practicality with a touch of playfulness, our Cardiff table lamp is a real charmer. Three swooping legs taper out to flattened feet, the tripod structure providing a sturdy foundation for the small lamp. Contrasting with the burnished brass finish artisans create by hand, the ivory cotton shade tops the lamp with a light touch and classic taper shape. Cardiff delights on a side table or nightstand and pairs delightfully with the coordinating floor lamps.

items.name: Dalton Brown Suede and Metal Dome Table Lamp by Jake Arnold 19.7"
items.description_en: Jake Arnold was inspired by some of his favorite Swedish lamps from the 1940s while designing Dalton. We love its materiality—the muted red-finished metal dome, burnished brass accents and suede-wrapped tube—as well as the neutral palette that suits any home. Ideal for a desk, the table lamp also provides a warm welcome on an entryway console table. Jake Arnold, interior designer and co-founder of The Expert, has a fresh talent for mixing insider-worthy details and real-life comfort that's made him one to watch. With this new collaboration, we're bringing the star designer's high-style look to every room of your home.

items.name: Isla Bronze Triangle Table Lamp 24"
items.description_en: Like refined steel beams finished in brass, pewter or near-black bronze, our Isla lamps grace tables with industrial beauty and architectural grace. Three gently curved panels welded together sculpt a slender pyramid topped with a contrasting bright white cotton drum shade for softly diffused light. The coordinating metallic clips of the built-in shade frame add dainty details. Designed for us by Blake Tovin of Tovin Design, our exclusive Isla triangle table lamps pair with the matching floor lamps for a unified room.

items.name: Seine Calacatta White Marble Mini Table Lamp with Rattan Shade 13"
items.description_en: A study in contrasts, our Seine table lamp pairs luxe, expressively veined marble with the breezy beauty and organic texture of rattan. The two natural materials harmonize effortlessly, unified by a warm palette and accentuated by burnished brass details. Scaled small, the lamp is perfectly proportioned for a nightstand, bookcase or petite side table.

items.name: Obelisk Brass Table Lamp with Brass Shade
items.description_en: Like its namesake, our Obelisk table lamp tapers as it rises dramatically from a square base. The six-sided shade continues the geometric minimalism, highlighted by the brass finish that unifies base and shade for a monolithic look. We love the way the facets subtly reflect the cast light. Obelisk has a strong, sculptural presence, while its golden gleam keeps the look warm, cozy and glamorous.

items.name: Ola Warm White Linen Mini Table Lamp 13"
items.description_en: Inspired by vintage lamps and shades, our Ola table lamp offers a contemporary take on a scalloped silhouette. The lamp's sculptural curves are covered in warm white fabric and echoed in the matching shade. The rounded contours offer a continuous play of shadow and highlight whether the lights are on or off. This table lamp is perfectly proportioned for a nightstand, bookcase or petite side table.

items.name: Braque Glass Cube Table Lamp by Jeremiah Brent
items.description_en: Inspired by the artistry and geometry of 1940s design, our stunning table lamp reproduces the alluring texture of hand-cast glass. Transparent glass shapes the cubed base and shade, which filter light in a fascinating fashion. Accented with pewter, Braque balances contemporary cool with the organic beauty of glass. Introducing The Collected Home. Our exclusive new collaboration with interior designer Jeremiah Brent is rich with bespoke details and bold individuality.

items.name: Quinn Grey and White Table Lamp 19"
items.description_en: Deep texture meets delicate crackling. On the upper portion of this rounded lamp, a matte white finish reveals the pocked earthenware below. A pale grey glaze adds subtle crackle to the smooth lower portion, for an intriguing balance of textured and polished, rough and refined. A white linen drum shade suits the serene grey and white table lamp, while a white ceramic ball finial finishes the look with a bit of whimsy. This lamp brings the perfect touch of texture and organic beauty to pale, minimalist spaces.

items.name: Larsen Sandstone Mini Table Lamp 15"
items.description_en: Elevated materials seamlessly unite in a small table lamp with organic glamour. Textured in the round with pinstripe grooves, a slim column of creamy sandstone rises from a burnished brass-finished base. The white linen drum shade filters light softly to complete the look. Slender and streamlined, our scaled-down Larsen lamp brings a luxe touch and diffuse illumination to nightstands, bookshelves and petite side tables.

items.name: Isla Brass Triangle Mini Table Lamp 13"
items.description_en: Our Isla lamp graces tables with industrial beauty and architectural grace. Three gently curved panels of brass-finished steel are welded together to sculpt a slender pyramid. items.name: Pompeii Warm White Large Ceramic Table Lamp
items.description_en: A modern take on ancient artifacts, our Pompeii table lamp pairs a rustic earthenware base with a crisp white linen shade. Pair this large lamp with its smaller counterpart or mix and match with the green version for fascinating illumination.

items.name: Remi Navy Blue Linen Mini Table Lamp 15"
items.description_en: Remi wraps a table lamp entirely in navy linen with gilded accents. Adding texture and softness to a bookcase or desk, our small Remi table lamp is also perfectly proportioned for a nightstand.

items.name: Aston Wood and Marble Table Lamp with Glass Shade 20"
items.description_en: A luxe mix of materials come together in our modern organic Aston table lamp. Deeply hued and richly veined, a subtly faceted round of burgundy marble shapes the substantial base. The rich tones of the walnut wood stem pair perfectly with the stone. Supported on an understated frame finished in burnished brass, the hand-blown cream glass shade casts a soft glow. The midcentury modern-inspired lamp has a warm, charming presence we can't resist.

items.name: Bramble Wood Table Lamp with Scalloped Fabric Shade 24"
items.description_en: Irresistibly cozy, our Bramble table lamp instantly warms your decor. Exaggerated scallops shape the elongated taper shade, the natural hemp borders in bright contrast with the rust-hued slubbed ramie. Crafted of fumed oak, the turned base enhances the lamp's Cotswolds-inspired countryside charm.

items.name: Pompeii Warm White Small Ceramic Table Lamp
items.description_en: A modern take on ancient artifacts, our Pompeii table lamp pairs a rustic earthenware base with a crisp white linen shade. Skilled artisans finish the lamp by hand, coating the ceramic urn with a chalky white glaze rich with speckles, pockmarks and subtle swaths of earthy hues. Petite loop handles add understated charm. items.name: Nossa Woven Seagrass Table Lamp 28"

The natural linen shade perfectly suits this coastal-inspired floor lamp and casts a diffuse glow. Pair with the other pieces in our Nossa collection to create a modern organic vibe.

items.name: Corfu Cream Table Lamp with Linen Drum Shade 26.6"
items.description_en: With its ginger jar curves and rustic finish, our Corfu table lamp illuminates interiors with perfect proportions and nuanced style. A painted earth-tone finish lends an artisan-like look to the base, while the drum shade complements with the neutral color and texture of the linen. Perfect for any room in the house, the Corfu table lamp is ours exclusively.

items.name: Lachlin Table Lamp 24"
items.description_en: The classic mid-century modern mushroom lamp updated with modern lines. A golden dome rests atop a slender cone, all plated in antique brushed brass. Charming pull chains turn the energy-efficient on and off, while the lampshade's white interior reflects light. Our Lachlin table lamp, a Crate and Barrel exclusive, adds a touch of gleaming glamour to a nightstand, side table or desk.

items.name: Larsen Sandstone Table Lamp 27"

items.name: Beachwood Golden Calacatta Marble Table Lamp with Wicker Shade 20.7" by Brigette Romanek
items.description_en: Playfully mixing materials, the Beachwood table lamp unites formal marble with laid-back rattan. We love the way the veining in the honed column of golden Calacatta marble echoes the warm hue of the breezy wicker shade, while the burnished brass-finished base and neck add a deeper, richer tone. Eclectic yet classic, the Beachwood table lamp lends a sculptural presence to a side table, entryway console or dresser. Exclusive collaboration! L.A.-based star designer Brigette Romanek redefines design rules as only she can, with playfully unexpected forms to bring you the fresh look her A-list clients love.

items.name: Vespera Glass Table Lamp 19.7"
items.description_en: Inspired by layered ice formations, our Vespera table lamp captures the ethereal beauty of frozen water. Made entirely of clear and subtly textured cast glass, the lamp features a curved panel base and a conical shade. Burnished brass-finished details warms the icy light, gleaming through the subtly textured glass. We love the exquisite presence of this lamp, especially paired with the coordinating Vespera flush mount light.

items.name: Millstone Fossil Beige Marble Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 16.5"
items.description_en: Small but stunning, our Millstone table lamp showcases exquisite Fossil Beige marble. The perfectly simple silhouette allows the warm white and beige swirls of the natural stone to shine. Woven of natural flax linen, a crisply angled taper shade provides the perfect complement to the rounded base. items.name: Seguin Black Metal Table Lamp
items.description_en: Rising from a sculptural tulip base, this graceful table lamp expands our Seguin lighting collection. A blackened steel finish contrasts with the crisp white linen shade for a graphic overall look that's an instant classic. Slim and refined, this table lamp fits perfectly on a nightstand or side table.

items.name: Petra Travertine Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 24.5"
items.description_en: Monolithic and minimalist, our Petra table lamp brings quiet drama to your decor. A tapered column of travertine forms the luxe base, accentuated by elegant facets that showcase the stone's distinctive pores and warm, creamy hue. Natural variations in the stone base make each lamp one-of-a-kind. The off-white linen shade is classic and understated, allowing the base to star while filtering light softly. The verticality of Petra makes it an ideal reading light on a side table or nightstand.

items.name: Millstone Breccia Marble Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 16.5"
items.description_en: Small but stunning, our Millstone table lamp showcases exquisite Breccia marble. The perfectly simple silhouette allows the richly swirled, deep brown stone to shine. This small-scale—but high-impact—table lamp fits perfectly on a bookshelf, desk or nightstand.

items.name: Isla Pewter Triangle Table Lamp 24"
items.description_en: Like a refined steel beam finished in shimmering pewter, our Isla lamp graces tables with industrial beauty and architectural grace. items.name: Ruins Black Ceramic Sculptural Table Lamp with Pleated Shade by Athena Calderone 20"

items.name: Seymour Telescoping Black Metal Table Lamp 25.2"

Pair the blackened steel table lamp with the coordinating telescoping floor lamp for adjustable lighting throughout the living room, home office or bedroom.

items.name: Icon 24" Green Ceramic Table Lamp by Venus Williams
items.description_en: Inspired by midcentury-modern silhouettes, our Icon table lamp plays with earthenware in an unexpected way. Our exclusive collaboration with tennis superstar Venus Williams highlights her 20 years of design expertise and unique creative vision.

items.name: Bowery Silver Table Lamp by Laura Harrier and Tiffany Howell

Enter a world of elegance, romance and fashion with our exclusive new collection created in collaboration with designer Tiffany Howell and actor Laura Harrier.

items.name: Zain Dark Pewter Grey Table Lamp with USB Port 18"
