Organic and artisanal yet undeniably glamorous, Swan is particularly suited to vanities, nightstands and entryways. Enter a world of elegance, romance and fashion with our exclusive new collection created in collaboration with designer Tiffany Howell and actor Laura Harrier.

items.name: Cardiff Black Table Lamp 16.5"
items.description_en: Balancing practicality with a touch of playfulness, our Cardiff table lamp is a real charmer. Three swooping legs taper out to flattened feet, the tripod structure providing a sturdy foundation for the small lamp. Contrasting with the hand-finished blackened metal, the ivory cotton shade tops the lamp with a light touch and classic taper shape. Cardiff delights on a side table or nightstand and pairs delightfully with the coordinating floor lamps.

items.name: Adamo Travertine Table Lamp with Metal Shade 12.4"
items.description_en: Inspired by vintage desk lamps , our Adamo lamp balances organic texture and sleek, modern style. A solid cylinder of honed travertine provides a stately foundation, showcasing the stone's distinctive pores and warm, creamy hues. Finished in ivory, the perforated steel shade provides a sleek counterpoint to the organic base and creates a mesmerizing play of light and shadow when the light is illuminated. Burnished brass-finished accents complete the lamp's look of timeless elegance.

items.name: Stafford Ivory Ceramic Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 29.5"
items.description_en: Reactive glaze warms a classic table lamp, elevating it with the cozy sophistication of handcrafted ceramics. Earthenware shapes Stafford's boldly curved silhouette, highlighted by high-gloss ivory glaze. A linen taper shade provides crisp contrast, keeping focus on Stafford's heritage charm and unique finish.

items.name: Den Brass Table Lamp with Metal Shade 14.25"
items.description_en: Sculptural yet livable, our space-age Den table lamp is warmed by its burnished brass finish. Gleaming metal shapes the columnar base and tiered, arching shades. The lower layer creates an intriguing play of light through a grid of petite perforations, while the top portion casts a wider glow. This small-scale lamp serves as a piece of gleaming jewelry for your bookshelf, mantel or nightstand.

items.name: Ruins Cream Ceramic Sculptural Table Lamp with Pleated Shade by Athena Calderone 20"
items.description_en: Like an abstract sculpture or the remains of a long-gone structure, our Ruins lamp makes a dramatic play of light and shadow. Made of textured stoneware, the cream base unites two intersecting forms with an open void in between that creates an intriguing balance of positive and negative space. A pleated taper shade in natural linen contrasts with clean lines and crisp pleats. Perched on a console table or sideboard, the eye-catching lamp provides a sculptural focal point to a living room or entryway. We've partnered with bestselling author, interior designer and EyeSwoon founder Athena Calderone to bring you a collection of designs for meaningful, beautiful modern living. Inspired by ancient forms and European finds, Crate x Athena fine-tunes scale, materials and comfort to fit seamlessly into your home.

items.name: Seymour Telescoping Brass Metal Table Lamp 25.25"
items.description_en: Seymour offers soft illumination right where you need it, raising or lowering easily with a turn of a knurled knob to precisely suit your space. Elevated upon a slender telescoping stem, the white tapered shade echoes the curves of the conical base. Pair the brass-finished table lamp with the coordinating telescoping floor lamp for adjustable lighting throughout the living room, home office or bedroom.

items.name: Idealist Metal Mini Table Lamp with Alabaster Shade 15"
items.description_en: Slabs of honed alabaster arranged in a pinwheel formation top our Idealist lamp with a stunning shade. The translucent stone diffuses light softly, making this petite table lamp ideal for a nightstand and bedtime reading. Finished in dark pewter, the tapered steel base provides crisp counterpoint to the organic beauty of the shade.

items.name: Pompeii Slate Large Ceramic Table Lamp
items.description_en: Our rustic-yet-modern Pompeii table lamp features a weathered earthenware base that's hand-finished to resemble an ancient artifact. Shaped like a classical urn, the ceramic base is coated by hand with layers of mottled grey-blue glaze uniquely toned and textured to make each lamp truly one of a kind. A white linen taper shade keeps the look fresh and contemporary.

items.name: Seraph Alabaster Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 27.2"
items.description_en: Inspired by abstract sculptures of the human form, our Seraph table lamp doubles as a work of art. Sculpted of exquisite alabaster, the base's hourglass curves and an oversized spherical finial showcase the stone's unique translucence, subtle veining and creamy, rosy hues. We adore the way light filters through the natural linen shade and luminous base to create a warm ambiance.

items.name: Brutalist Metal Table Lamp with Metal Shade 18.5"
items.description_en: Inspired by Brutalist sculptures, this table lamp makes a strong statement of industrial beauty. Cast aluminum shapes a bisected monolithic base, softened by the highly textured dark pewter finish that adds organic warmth and depth. Finished in gleaming burnished brass, the faceted shade offers crisp contrast and a touch of glam. We love the striking presence and raw materiality our Brutalist lamp brings to modern spaces.

items.name: Pina Pro Dark Grey Metal Table Lamp by Zafferano America 11.4"
items.description_en: Illuminate small spaces with adjustable light and stylish design, no cords required. Made of grey-finished aluminum, the petite table lamp fashions a modern silhouette with conical base, slender tube and mini taper shade with diffuser to cast an even, bright layer of light. The integrated LED bulb turns on and dims with the touch of a finger and offers up to 13 hours of illumination. To recharge, return the battery-operated lamp to its contact induction charging base. Thanks to its durable powdercoat finish, the dark grey lamp can be used indoors or out and is bathroom safe.

items.name: Toulon Tall Ceramic Table Lamp with White Shade
items.description_en: The Toulon table lamp shines a spotlight on sculptural shapes and earthy texture. Modeled with a coarse texture inspired by lunar rocks, the gently tapered base contrasts with a sleek linen drum shade. We especially love the tall lamp's organic warmth on a dresser, entryway console or nightstand.

items.name: Chez Red Marble Mini Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 14"
items.description_en: A stunning cylinder of red marble provides a fascinating foundation for this petite table lamp, showcasing the stone's dramatic veining in bold, warm hues. The understated fabric shade diffuses light softly while keeping all of the attention on the natural marble. This striking lamp stuns on a side table, entryway console or nightstand.

items.name: Noir Turned Wood Table Lamp with Fabric Shade
items.description_en: Our Noir table lamp adds dark drama to your decor as it illuminates your space. Crafted of sustainably sourced oak with a rough-hewn, ebonized finish, the turned base has an eye-catching silhouette that reminds us of midcentury-modern wooden sculptures. The natural linen shade completes the organic feel while adding crisp, clean lines—we especially love the way the charming finial echoes the lathed layers.

items.name: Icon 24" Clay Ceramic Table Lamp by Venus Williams
items.description_en: Inspired by midcentury-modern silhouettes, our Icon table lamp plays with earthenware in an unexpected way. Ceramic shapes the columnar base and fluted dome shade, all glossily glazed in an earthy blush hue the color of clay tennis courts. The stem and finial finished in burnished brass gleam in the lamp's glow. Icon is perfectly proportioned for entryway consoles, large side tables and credenzas. The Power of Great Design. Our exclusive collaboration with tennis superstar Venus Williams highlights her 20 years of design expertise and unique creative vision.

items.name: Cardiff Brass Table Lamp 23.25"
items.description_en: Balancing practicality with a touch of playfulness, our Cardiff table lamp is a real charmer. Three swooping legs taper out to flattened feet, the tripod structure providing a sturdy foundation for the tall lamp. Contrasting with the burnished brass finish artisans create by hand, the ivory cotton shade tops the lamp with a light touch and classic taper shape. Cardiff delights on a side table or nightstand and pairs delightfully with the coordinating floor lamps.

items.name: Vidro Glass Table Lamp with Brass Shade 27"
items.description_en: Our elevated take on a classic glass table lamp, Vidro pairs fluted glass with burnished brass-finished steel. The light cast sparkles on the rippled glass and causes the warmly hued metal to gleam. Suitable for modern and traditional decor, this lamp creates a cozy reading spot placed on a side table next to a sofa or armchair.

items.name: Strata Travertine Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 24.5"
items.description_en: Our Strata table lamp stacks travertine slabs to evoke both ancient temples and modern skyscrapers. The stone's distinctive pores and creamy hue warm the linear silhouette, while alternating squares of brass-finished steel add unexpected glam. The natural linen drum shade complements with additional organic texture and contrasting curves. Strata has a stately look on a desk, entryway console or dresser.

items.name: Millstone Bordeaux Marble Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 16.5"
items.description_en: Small but stunning, our Millstone table lamp showcases exquisite marble. The perfectly simple silhouette allows the richly veined, Bordeaux-hued stone to shine. Woven of natural flax linen, a crisply angled taper shade provides the perfect complement to the rounded base. This small-scale—but high-impact—table lamp fits perfectly on a bookshelf, desk or nightstand.

items.name: Cadre Travertine Table Lamp with Fabric Shade 20.5"
items.description_en: Stately and monolithic, our Cadre table lamp has an undeniable-yet-understated presence. A stunning slab of travertine sculpts the linear base, warmed and textured by the stone's distinctive pores and creamy hue. Filtering light beautifully, the natural linen shade echoes the clean-lined geometry. We especially love the Cadre lamp in pairs on an entryway console, dining room buffet or pair of nightstands.

items.name: Eino Blue Ceramic Table Lamp 26.5"
items.description_en: Charmingly off-kilter checks texture our Eino table lamp with an organic pattern and playful feel. Glazed in matte dark blue, the cylindrical ceramic base rests upon a subtle pedestal and is topped with a tall linen shade that continues the natural, artisanal look. We especially love placing our exclusive Eino ceramic lamp where its unique surface can be admired.

items.name: Trousdale Brass Perforated Metal Mini Table Lamp 15"
items.description_en: Our Trousdale table lamp stacks a series of hexagons to create a clean, modern silhouette. The burnished brass finish warms the geometric design for an impeccable blend of contemporary and cozy. We love the way light gleams on the metal surfaces and the sparkle created by the square perforations that rim the shade. Trousdale is perfectly proportioned for a nightstand, bookcase or petite side table.

items.name: Beleza Metal Table Lamp by Jeremiah Brent
items.description_en: Jeremiah Brent believes lighting is the easiest way to elevate a space—and the Beleza lamp instantly updates the room with elegant contrast. The juxtaposition of the delicately pleated linen lampshade against the industrial-chic perforated metal base is cool and contemporary. Burnished brass trim unites the round shade with the hexagonal base while adding dynamic details. Introducing The Collected Home. Our exclusive new collaboration with interior designer Jeremiah Brent is rich with bespoke details and bold individuality.

items.name: Rossi 17" Red Table Lamp with Glass Shade by Venus Williams
items.description_en: Sculptural and striking, our Rossi lamp has a high-impact presence. The bold base ripples and swells, its organic silhouette emphasized by a rich oxblood finish. Opalescent glass shapes the arced shade, a gentle counterpart that filters light softly. Detailed with burnished brass, Rossi looks fabulous—on or off—on an entryway console, side table or nightstand. The Power of Great Design. Our exclusive collaboration with tennis superstar Venus Williams highlights her 20 years of design expertise and unique creative vision.

items.name: Poldina Pro Steel Blue Metal Table Lamp by Zafferano America 15"
items.description_en: This ingenious design lets you bring the classic look and illumination of a table lamp wherever it's needed, no cords required. Made of aluminum in steel blue, the clean-lined lamp fashions a modern silhouette with a slender tube and petite taper shade. An integrated LED bulb turns on and dims with the touch of a finger and offers up to nine hours of illumination. To recharge, return the battery-operated lamp to its contact induction charging base. Thanks to its durable powdercoat finish, the dark blue lamp can be used indoors or out and is bathroom safe.

items.name: Velato Glass Table Lamp 19.5" with Blue Shade
items.description_en: Velato combines unexpected color, sculptural form and tinted glass in a table lamp that defies expectations. Rising from a burnished brass-finished base, a column of smoky slate grey glass surrounds a slender central stem. A gleaming metal ring cinches the tube to give the tall lamp eye-catching curves and a striking silhouette. The blue fabric shade provides a colorful counterpoint, completing the contemporary look.

items.name: Caen Travertine Table Lamp with Ivory Shade
items.description_en: The Caen table lamp shines a spotlight on the organic beauty of travertine. Topped with an elongated ivory paper shade, the lamp casts soft illumination on the creamy, highly textural stone. The recessed plinth base gives a bit of a lift to Caen's earthy presence. We love the lamp's warmth on a dresser, entryway console or nightstand.

items.name: Courbe Green Ceramic Table Lamp with Rattan Shade by Athena Calderone 24.2"
items.description_en: Rooted in ancient forms with a textured twist, our Courbe lamp is sophisticated, approachable and ready to light up living rooms, entryways and bedrooms. The lamp's bottle-shaped base showcases the one-of-a-kind markings of reactive glaze in a matte rustic green with the look of a treasured artifact. The dramatically angled taper shade lends a breezy note, woven out of natural rattan complete with artisanal ribbing and a lash-finished rim. We've partnered with bestselling author, interior designer and EyeSwoon founder Athena Calderone to bring you a collection of designs for meaningful, beautiful modern living. Inspired by ancient forms and European finds, Crate x Athena fine-tunes scale, materials and comfort to fit seamlessly into your home.

items.name: Poldina Pro Dark Grey Metal Table Lamp by Zafferano America 15"
items.description_en: This ingenious design lets you bring the classic look and illumination of a table lamp to any room in the house, no cords required. Made of aluminum with a dark grey finish, the clean-lined lamp fashions a modern silhouette with a slender tube and petite taper shade. An integrated LED bulb turns on and dims with the touch of a finger and offers up to nine hours of illumination. To recharge, return the battery-operated lamp to its contact induction charging base. Thanks to its durable powdercoat finish, the lamp can be used indoors or out.

items.name: Karina Ivory Table Lamp 28.5"
items.description_en: Deep ribbing textures our Karina table lamp, giving it the classical look of an ancient artifact. Hand-formed by skilled artisans, the terracotta base has a raw, pitted surface unified by the matte ivory finish. Topped with a slightly tapered jute shade in a matching hue, our Karina lamp has a regal yet approachable presence on a console, side table or dresser.

items.name: Corfu Black Table Lamp with Linen Drum Shade 26.6"
items.description_en: With its ginger jar curves and rustic finish, our Corfu table lamp illuminates interiors with perfect proportions and nuanced style. A painted blackfinish lends an artisan-like look to the base, while the drum shade complements with the neutral color and texture of the linen. Perfect for any room in the house, the Corfu table lamp is ours exclusively.

items.name: Vestige Parchment Table Lamp
items.description_en: This monochrome lamp keeps all the focus on its remarkable materials. Parchment wraps our sculptural Vestige table lamp, finished in a lacquered high-gloss finish that showcases the naturally creamy hues. Echoing the base's tiered racetrack curves, the raw silk shade adds organic texture and a soft glow. We especially love Vestige's serene presence and filtered light in a bedroom or foyer. Subtle variations in the parchment make each exquisite lamp beautifully unique.

items.name: Facette White Vases by Athena Calderone
items.description_en: Everyone needs the perfect vase that acts as a decorative object or a container for dried botanicals. Enter Facette. Imperfect to the core with a texture inspired by hand-troweled finishes, the faceted white vase can stand alone or hold dried blooms. Athena Calderone especially loves a pair of her well-weighted vases displayed on an entry table with dried branches or a single petite Facette holding faux peonies atop a favorite book on a coffee table. We've partnered with bestselling author, interior designer and EyeSwoon founder Athena Calderone to bring you a collection of designs for meaningful, beautiful modern living. Inspired by ancient forms and European finds, Crate x Athena fine-tunes scale, materials and comfort to fit seamlessly into your home.

items.name: Ophelia Matte Vases 7.5"-17"
items.description_en: Master potters transform simple clay into a dramatic vase. Thrown, finished and painted by hand, the terracotta vessel features a textured surface enhanced by a stippled green finish. The generous curves of the vase swell from a low foot to shape a striking silhouette with a slender neck. Place our olive Ophelia vase on a mantel or sideboard where its artistry can be appreciated, or use it to present fresh, dried and faux botanicals.

items.name: Antiguo Terracotta Vases
items.description_en: Inspired by ancient ceramics discovered on the coast of Italy, our petite Antiguo vase showcases the same timeless artisanship. Skilled craftspeople shape each vessel by hand, streamlining the classic curves and graceful handle. A highly textural matte cream glaze gives the one-of-a-kind vase a plaster-like finish for a found-object look and feel. We love it on its own or filled with our lush faux botanicals.

items.name: Pompeii Ceramic Bowl and Vase Collection
items.description_en: Our Pompeii vase collection fascinates with reactive glazes and artisanal textures that evoke the patina of ancient artifacts. Crackled pale blue and cream glazes coat the small ceramic vase, accented on the neck and base with deep indigo that highlights the classical silhouette. Rustic texture applied by hand enhances the organic warmth of the vase. Display on its own, filled with botanicals or grouped with our other Pompeii pottery on a bookshelf, buffet or mantel. Due to the reactive glazes and handcrafted techniques, each vase is one of a kind.

items.name: Berkshire Vases
items.description_en: Inspired by picturesque villages in England's Berkshire region, this vase epitomizes cozy sophistication. Skilled artisans form each one by hand, creating classical curves in richly textured terracotta. A rich brown finish is then applied by hand—matte on the smooth portions, semi-matte on the rough—for the look of beautifully aged ceramics. Fill the small urn-shaped vase with dried or faux botanicals for just the right amount of countryside charm.

items.name: Apone Iron Vases
items.description_en: Modern-meets-Bronze Age in our Apone vases. Skilled artisans finish each one by hand, highlighting the bronze vases' clean curves with an antiqued bronze patina. The look is warm, timeless and striking, whether the small and large vases are displayed on their own, in a sculptural pair or filled with botanicals.

items.name: Waverly Porcelain Vase
items.description_en: Our Waverly vase fascinates with texture on texture. Hand-formed into deep ripples, durable porcelain shapes the seedpod-shaped vessel. Slender etching adds organic depth and emphasizes the flowing curves. Glazed by hand in warm taupe, the small vase pairs a matte exterior with a glossy white lining.

items.name: Eider Glass Vases
items.description_en: Our Eider bud vases show off a perfect stem or two. Highly skilled artisans blow recycled glass into a charmingly organic shape topped with a flared lip. We love the way the brown tint contrasts warmly with the lush hues of fresh botanicals. Handcrafted techniques create bubbles and swirls that make each large bud vase delightfully unique.

items.name: Hawthorne Vases
items.description_en: Vintage vase silhouettes inspired our Hawthorne collection. Crafted by hand with a wide shoulder, this large vase has a dramatic profile and presence. Skilled artisans texture the earthenware by hand with an organic crosshatched grid before adding a wash of creamy white glaze that reveals glimpses of the clay below. The sculptural vase stands on its own or lends a stately air to fresh floral arrangements.

items.name: Rochester Ceramic Vases 8"-17"
items.description_en: Our Rochester vases marry midcentury modern silhouettes with English manor house style. Coated by hand with reactive glazes, the stately ceramic vessels showcase earthy and organic yet high-gloss finishes for a warm, refined look. The small vase is speckled in brown hues that create depth and richness unique to each vase.

items.name: Alura Cream Tall Vase
items.description_en: Textured lines enliven the surface of this graceful tall vase of cream-colored porcelain. Pair with the other off-white vases in our exclusive Alura collection for sculptural impact.

items.name: Marble Round Ball Vase 7"
items.description_en: The simple spherical structure of this vase allows the gorgeous marble to star. Richly veined in rosy cocoa and burgundy hues, the creamy matte stone fascinates with organic beauty. This sculptural vase stands on its own or displays petite dried and faux botanicals.

items.name: Fleur Clear Handblown Glass Vases
items.description_en: Our elevated take on the classic clear glass vase, Fleur instantly upgrades arrangements. Skilled artisans blow each one by hand, creating a curved rim that allows stems to fan gracefully outward. Ideal for showing off ready-made bouquets to their best advantage—just drop in and go—the medium vase also looks stunning and sculptural with just a few fresh, faux or dried botanicals.

items.name: Ithaca Vases 10"-16"
items.description_en: Our Ithaca collection celebrates the fascinating forms and textures of artisan ceramics. Skilled craftspeople cast each organically shaped vase by hand, scratching or pressing the porcelain to create unique surfaces before finishing the graceful, freeform pieces with matte glazes. Striking enough to stand on their own as sculptures, our Ithaca vases also pair beautifully with branches and other botanicals.

items.name: Direction Vase
items.description_en: This stunning vase's simple profile is brilliantly accented with a single bubble formed in its thick sham for a clean, classic look.

items.name: Curvy Ribbed Ceramic Vases by Cym Warkov
items.description_en: Uniquely textured and voluptuous in form, this vase was inspired by the human body. Ceramic artist Cym Warkov designed the vessel with an organic, timeless silhouette that expresses elegance in simplicity. Skilled artisans finish and glaze each earthenware vase by hand in serene cream, keeping all of the attention on the curvaceous sweep of the form-enhancing ribbing. This vase is watertight, making it ideal for filling with water to display fresh botanicals, the vase stands on its own as a work of sculpture.

items.name: Melbourne Porcelain Vase
items.description_en: Epitomizing coastal chic, our Melbourne vase brings to mind rippled grey sand beaches or stormy waves. Talented artisans form the vase's graceful curves by hand before carving the flowing texture. Glossy white glaze on the interior contrasts with the dusty green exterior. Pair the small vase with its larger blue and cream counterparts for an understated oceanic arrangement.

items.name: Renata Small Glass Dark Blue Vase 6"
items.description_en: Our Renata vases practically glow from within. Hand-blown by skilled artisans, the fluted glass is etched to create a matte frosted finish that reminds us of seaglass. The ocean blue hue fascinates with its lush depth. Gorgeous on its own or filled with botanicals, this small vase does double duty as a hurricane that captivates with diffused candlelight.

items.name: Norton Slim Dark Green Vase 13"
items.description_en: Slim and gracefully curved, our Norton vase stands in as a sculptural stem for botanicals. Skilled artisans etch a dainty organic grid into white porcelain before coating the textured exterior with semi-matte olive green. The look is warm, refined and timeless.

items.name: Les Crêtes White Textured Vase 18" by Athena Calderone
items.description_en: According to Athena Calderone, we all need an oversized, weighted vessel that can accommodate beloved branches—Crêtes is it. Bulbous and sculptural, the sculptural and streaked white vase commands attention on the table, counter or mantel. The hand-applied, raked ridges bring a further layer of texture to the nubby vase. Our favorite feature is the cement-like, rough-hewn finish which drives home the artisanal legacy of the piece. We've partnered with bestselling author, interior designer and EyeSwoon founder Athena Calderone to bring you a collection of designs for meaningful, beautiful modern living. Inspired by ancient forms and European finds, Crate x Athena fine-tunes scale, materials and comfort to fit seamlessly into your home.

items.name: Alura Low-Wide Cream White Porcelain Vase
items.description_en: Textured lines enliven the surface of this graceful vase, finishing the vessel with an artisanal look. Crafted of cream-glazed porcelain, the low-wide vase accommodates full, lush arrangements and grounds tall single stems. Pair with the other off-white vases in our exclusive Alura collection for sculptural impact.

items.name: Cognac Small Brown Glass Vase 5" by Laura Harrier and Tiffany Howell
items.description_en: Channeling a mood that feels romantic, sculptural and emotionally resonant, our Cognac vase captures the seductive appeal of '70s glam decor. An amorphous volume of warm brown glass is suspended within a clear sphere for a floating, organic effect. Hand-blown by highly skilled artisans, the luxe vase transforms simple stems into a dramatic statement. Enter a world of elegance, romance and fashion with our exclusive new collection created in collaboration with designer Tiffany Howell and actor Laura Harrier.

items.name: Oaxaca Cotton Mache Vases
items.description_en: Our Oaxaca collection transforms scrap fabric into stately vases with organic warmth. Skilled artisans press fabric pulp into an urn-like shape, which is then painted by hand with an earthy matte finish in toasty taupe. Rows of incised dashes texture the vessel with rustic interest. Fascinating on its own, the large vase also makes a beautiful presentation of dried and faux branches.

items.name: Rose Tinted Round Glass Vase 9" by Laura Harrier and Tiffany Howell
items.description_en: Balancing elegance and surprise, our Rose-Tinted vase captures the seductive appeal of '70s glam decor. Rosy mauve glass shapes the spherical vessel, overlaid with ribbons of clear glass. Hand-blown by highly skilled artisans, the luxe vase transforms simple stems into a dramatic statement. Enter a world of elegance, romance and fashion with our exclusive new collection created in collaboration with designer Tiffany Howell and actor Laura Harrier.

items.name: Toluca Large Beige Ceramic Textured Vase 17"
items.description_en: Richly and unpredictably textured, reactive glaze drips down our Toluca vase to create a fascinating texture. Smooth, matte beige underglaze coats the large vase, revealing glimpses of the terracotta below. Reactive glaze in the same hue is then drizzled on top for the feel of a found artifact. The streamlined shape keeps all the attention on the unique glazes, with the tonal palette unifying the look. Display-worthy on its own, earthy Toluca contrasts with fresh botanicals for a striking arrangement.

items.name: Alura Cream Open Vase
items.description_en: This dramatically different vase shapes a textured ring of cream-colored porcelain. Stunning on its own, the watertight vase has a small opening at the top to host a tropical leaf or single bloom. Pair with the other off-white vases in our exclusive Alura collection for sculptural impact.

items.name: Clyborne Textured White Ceramic Vase 16"
items.description_en: The amorphous shape, unique texture and artisanal quality of our white Clyborne vase let it stand on its own as a work of modern sculpture. Modeled with swelling contours and peekaboo openings, the abstract design encourages interpretation—perhaps you see a fish in its textured curves. Glazed by hand, the clay vessel offers a striking presentation of single stems or lush floral arrangements. Our exclusive Clyborne white ceramic vase pairs with its shorter black counterpart for a high-contrast display, with or without botanicals.

items.name: Marla White Paper Mache Vase 19"
items.description_en: Our Marla collection's sculptural presence belies its light and airy construction. Skilled craftspeople apply recycled cotton pulp to a mold to create this textured, statement-making vase. Organic curves and facets lend the tall vase the look of an ancient artifact—made modern by the go-with-everything matte cream finish.

items.name: Serpentine Tall Brown Swirl Glass Vase 16" by Laura Harrier and Tiffany Howell
items.description_en: Balancing elegance and surprise, our tall Serpentine vase captures the seductive appeal of '70s glam decor. Clear glass shapes the graceful curves, wrapped in swirls of warm brown glass. Hand-blown by highly skilled artisans, the luxe vase transforms simple stems into a dramatic statement. Enter a world of elegance, romance and fashion with our exclusive new collection created in collaboration with designer Tiffany Howell and actor Laura Harrier.

items.name: Timber Grey Floor Vase
items.description_en: A simple shape made spectacular, our handcrafted tall floor vase exhibits unexpected texture and a nature-inspired hand painted surface. Resembling the organic look of tree bark, the vase makes a harmonious display of dried botanicals or faux branches.

items.name: Harbour Ombre Porcelain Vases
items.description_en: Our Harbour vases capture the point where sea meets sand. Light grey glaze flows into dusty blue or blue-green in an oceanic ombre effect that enhances the calm curves or dynamic angles. Skilled artisans craft each vase by hand, sculpting durable porcelain, texturing it with slender scratched ribbing and coating it with the dreamy matte glazes. Abstract and sculptural, the Harbour vases set a serene mood on their own or filled with fresh botanicals.

items.name: Alford Brown Woven Rattan Double Handle Vases
items.description_en: The classical silhouette of an ancient Italian amphora, reimagined in wicker. Stained warm brown, natural rattan is handwoven by skilled artisans into a dramatically curved vase finished with a braided rim and twisted, gracefully arched handles. The result is fresh, organic and modern with a touch of whimsy. Use this small vase to display our faux botanicals, or group with the other pieces in the Alford collection for a new take on a timeless classic.

items.name: Fluted White Marble Picture Frames
items.description_en: This delightful round frame puts the focus on your favorite photo. Made of gorgeous white marble, the frame is carved by hand with ribbing that radiates like a sunburst from the featured picture. The small frame is perfect for display on a bookshelf, desk or vanity table.

items.name: Signature Silver 5x7 Picture Frame
items.description_en: Let your favorite photograph shine with our Signature frame. The matless design highlights a treasured picture with an attention-getting border of silver-finished stainless steel.

items.name: Brushed Antique Bronze 4x6 Picture Frame
items.description_en: Our brushed antique bronze frame adds drama to photo displays with its shadow-box styling and oversized off-white mat. The square frame sets off rectangular photos for a unique profile. items.description_en: Create an instant gallery with this three-frame set. Our brushed silver frames add drama and shine to photo displays with their shadow-box styling and oversized off-white mats. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, this trio of stainless steel 11"x14" frames with a brushed silver finish can be displayed in a vertical or horizontal line or arranged as a staggered gallery wall.

items.name: 6-Piece Brushed Brass 11x11 Gallery Wall Frame Set
items.description_en: Create an instant gallery wall with this six-frame set. Our brushed brass frames add gleaming drama to photo displays with their shadow-box styling and oversized off-white mats. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, the sextet of aluminum 11"x11" frames with a brushed brass finish can be displayed in a grid, in a long line down a hallway or arranged as a staggered gallery wall.

items.name: Icon Wood 5-Piece Black Gallery Wall Frame Set
items.description_en: Create an instant gallery with this five-frame set. The classic frames give treasured photos the presentation they deserve. Thick white mats and beveled black frames elevate the most casual snapshot, and the impeccable proportions and crisp black-and-white perfectly suit modern decor. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, the set unites 5"x"7 and 8"x10" wood frames with a black finish. Display the quintet in a dynamic row above a sofa or down a hallway or staircase.

items.name: Oslo Gallery Wall Frames Set of 5
items.description_en: Our frame collection makes it super easy to create a coordinated, eye-catching gallery wall of your favorite pictures. Channeling prized heirlooms, the black-finished frames are all made of sustainably sourced wood, showcase vintage-inspired detailing, accommodate a range of image sizes, and hang vertically or horizontally. Stately Belfast gives a timeless look to treasured pictures with linear molding and a wirebrushed finish for added texture. Carved by hand with beaded detailing, our Belgium frames are embellished in gold foil for a vintage look. Edinburg lends old world elegance, hand carved with intricate molding reminiscent of ornate French Rococo style.

items.name: 4-Piece Brushed Silver 11x11 Gallery Wall Frame Set
items.description_en: Create an instant gallery wall with this four-frame set. Our brushed silver frames add drama and shine to photo displays with their shadow-box styling and oversized off-white mats. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, the quartet of aluminum 11"x11" frames with a brushed silver finish can be displayed in a grid, in a line down a hallway or arranged as a staggered gallery wall.

items.name: 9-Piece Brushed Silver 4x6 Gallery Wall Frame Set
items.description_en: Create an instant gallery with this nine-frame set. Our brushed silver frames add drama and shine to photo displays with their shadow-box styling and oversized off-white mats. The square frames set off rectangular photos for a unique profile. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, the set of nine aluminum 4"x6" frames with a brushed silver finish can be displayed in a grid, in a long line down a hallway or arranged as a staggered gallery wall.

items.name: 4-Piece Brushed Black 11x11 Gallery Wall Frame Set
items.description_en: Create an instant gallery wall with this four-frame set. Our brushed black frames add dark drama to photo displays with their shadow-box styling and oversized off-white mats. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, the quartet of aluminum 11"x11" frames with a gunmetal finish can be displayed in a grid, in a line down a hallway or arranged as a staggered gallery wall.

items.name: 4-Piece Brushed Antique Bronze 11x11 Gallery Wall Frame Set
items.description_en: Create an instant gallery wall with this four-frame set. Our brushed antique bronze frames add drama to photo displays with their shadow-box styling and oversized off-white mats. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, the quartet of aluminum 11"x11" frames with a brushed antique bronze finish can be displayed in a grid, in a line down a hallway or arranged as a staggered gallery wall.

items.name: 2-Piece Brushed Black 11x11 Gallery Wall Frame Set
items.description_en: Create an instant gallery wall with this two-frame set. Our brushed black frames add dark drama to photo displays with their shadow-box styling and oversized off-white mats. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, the pair of aluminum 11"x11" frames with a brushed gunmetal finish can be displayed in a vertical, horizontal or diagonal arrangement.

items.name: Berlin Gallery Wall Frame Set of 5
items.description_en: Our frame collection makes it super easy to create a coordinated, eye-catching gallery wall of your favorite pictures. Channeling prized heirlooms, the handcrafted frames are all made of sustainably sourced wood, showcase vintage-inspired detailing, accommodate a range of image sizes, and hang vertically or horizontally. Stately Belfast gives a timeless look to treasured pictures with linear molding and a wirebrushed finish for added texture. Four Edinburgh frames feature ornate French Rococo-style molding—one made of cast resin with an antique bronze finish and three crafted of hand-carved wood with finishes in black, honey oak and whitewashed oak.

items.name: 4-Piece Brushed Silver Gallery Wall Frame Set
items.description_en: Create an instant gallery with this four-frame set. Our brushed silver frames add drama and shine to photo displays with their shadow-box styling and oversized off-white mats. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, the set unites 4"x6", 5"x7", 8"x10" and 11"x14" frames with a brushed silver finish. Display the quartet in a grid, in a line down a hallway or arranged as a staggered gallery wall.

items.name: Brushed Silver 11x11 Picture Frame
items.description_en: Our brushed silver square frame adds drama and shine to photo displays with its shadow-box styling and oversized off-white mat. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, our aluminum 11"x11" frame with a silver finish can be displayed on a mantel, bookshelf or table.

items.name: Rivington Gallery Wall Frames Set of 5
items.description_en: Our frame collection makes it super easy to create a coordinated, eye-catching gallery wall of your favorite pictures. Channeling prized heirlooms, the handcrafted frames are all made of sustainably sourced acacia wood, showcase vintage-inspired detailing, accommodate a range of image sizes, and hang vertically or horizontally. An assortment of our Edinburgh frames feature ornate French Rococo-style molding carved by hand and finishes in walnut, honey oak, and whitewashed oak. Our Halifax frame brings notched detailing to the mix along with a warm finish.

items.name: All-Clad ® Simply Strain 6-Qt. Stainless Steel Multipot with Straining Lid
items.description_en: Expertly prepare pasta, soup and sauces as well as steamed vegetables and seafood with this multifunctional pot. Crafted of stainless steel, the multipot has a wide, heavy-duty base for efficient heating. Wide handles allow for easy handling even with pot holders. The pot features interior measurement markings, and the straining lid locks into place to easily drain water from noodles, potatoes, corn on the cob and more. All-Clad has been crafting cookware since 1971.

items.name: KitchenAid ® 8-Qt. Stainless Steel Stockpot with Lid
items.description_en: Sandwiched between two layers of heavy-duty stainless steel, an extra-thick layer of conductive aluminum distributes heat evenly from edge to edge of this covered stock pot. The large pan cooks up mashed potatoes, corn on the cob or chili for a crowd, while the tempered glass lid locks in flavor and heat. With etched measurement markings on the interior to aid in adding ingredients, the durable stainless steel stock pot stands up to daily use and cleans up easily in the dishwasher. KitchenAid has been creating high-quality kitchenware for over a century.

items.name: "Heading South" Green Canvas Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Our giclee print of the original photograph captures a flock of birds taking flight. Appearing as flecks of white against a dark sky of deep, modulated green tones, the flight formation takes on an abstract quality that gives this work its contemporary edge. Each print is presented in a wood floater frame with a natural finish.

items.name: "Intermezzo" by Lillian Winkler Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Layers of metallic pigment and thinned oil paint give Lillian Winkler's painting a dreamlike quality. In an evocative palette of off-white, bright blue and tonal earth tones, she suggests sky, clouds and earth in a composition that's both abstract and recognizable as a landscape. Our giclee print on linen captures all the intricate layering of the original and is complemented by a wood frame finished in black and antique gold.

items.name: "Mineral" by Joe Turner Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Drawn to the angular shapes and subtle tones of rock formations, Joe Turner created rich texture in an earthy palette to emulate the look of natural stones. Stark contrasts, nuanced modeling and fine lines create an intriguing abstract composition with neutral tones to go with any setting. Our giclee print on canvas of the original acrylic painting is hand-embellished with additional texture to give it a fresh-off-the-easel look.

items.name: "Natural Daisy Chain" Wall Art 48"x36" by Leanne Ford
items.description_en: Our Daisy Chain fiber artwork designed by Leanne Ford graces the wall with neutral color and organic texture. Humble cotton thread groups in bands to fashion a dynamic basketweave of nuanced cream tones and pleasing asymmetry. Wrapped around a lightweight aluminum frame, this decor-friendly wall art piece hangs vertically or horizontally. We love its light color and natural appeal, especially when displayed in a room peppered with our handcrafted vases and baskets.

items.name: "La Bain" by Carolyn Misterek 32" x 42" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Without plan or forethought, Carolyn Misterek let intuition guide her marks and color choices in creating this vivid and expressive artwork. The uplifting palette of garden-like hues recalls Impressionist paintings of sun-filled gardens, bringing light and color to any room in the house. Our giclee print on canvas captures the vibrancy of the original oil on wood artwork and is perfectly complemented by a pine frame finished in antique gold.

items.name: "Chimes" Metal Wall Art Sculpture
items.description_en: Inspired by traditional wind chimes, iron disks dotted with brass soldering cascade in delicate garlands above a sofa or entryway table. Hang this intriguing metal artwork vertically or horizontally, patterning the wall with sculptural dimension and intriguing shadows.

items.name: "Heading South" Blue Canvas Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Our giclee print of the original photograph captures a flock of birds taking flight. Appearing as flecks of white against a dark sky of deep, modulated blue tones, the flight formation takes on an abstract quality that gives this work its contemporary edge. Each print is presented in a wood floater frame with a natural finish.

items.name: "Balance" by Huda Hashim 75" x 47" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: A modern statement in monochromatic taupe, this composition gains intricacy and depth from scumbled brushwork and ghostly marks. Huda Hashim's original acrylic painting is captured with all its nuance in our giclee print enhanced with hand-applied texture and framed in gold-finished hardwood.

items.name: "Slice" Teak Wall Art 19"x35"
items.description_en: Add organic interest to living room, bedroom and dining spaces with this stunning piece of wall art. Showcasing an intriguing slice of solid teak root, this natural work of art resonates with modern design with its expressive shape and elegant rusticity. Treated only with a fine application sanding, each piece of wood displays its own fascinating grain, knots and gnarls and rich coloring, which will darken over time.

items.name: "August Growth" by Sadie Byron 29"x38" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Artist Sadie Bryon brings her experience as both a sculptor and a floral designer to this delightful still life. Simplified shapes, expressive brushwork and an up-close vantage point underscore the lush forms and vibrancy of a vase brimming with foliage and flowers in full bloom Originally painted in oils, this charming still life is reproduced as a giclee print and presented in a wood frame finished with silver leaf.

items.name: "Path To Light Print" by Huda Hashim Hand-Painted 77.25"x31.25" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Using bold strokes, feathery marks and layered strokes of modulated color, Huda Hashim creates an abstract landscape rich with movement. The work's long horizontal form and neutral palette of browns, grey, white and black enhance the organic feel. We've captured all the vibrancy and detail of the original acrylic painting in our giclée print on canvas, enhanced with handpainted detail and a slim wood frame.

items.name: "A Painting For My Fathers Home" by Maggie Macdonald 61.5" x 31.5" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: In Maggie Macdonald's intriguing composition, abstract shapes fit together like a stone wall or tile mosaic. Ranging in tone from deep grey to pink to gold and varying in texture from matte to line-enhanced, the disparate elements coalesce into a unified whole full of nuance and movement. Hand-applied texture gives the giclee print the look of the original acrylic painting, while the hardwood frame anchors the look with warm brown finish.

items.name: Santos Volcanic Ash Wall Art
items.description_en: Molded from a mixture of volcanic ash, resin and fiberglass, this minimalist relief sculpture enlivens your space with dynamic and dimensional pattern. The artwork unites four rippled squares in a deceptively simple composition made moody and mysterious by a charcoal grey hand-painted finish.

items.name: "Dune" Hand-Carved Bleached Wood Wall Art 30"x30"
items.description_en: Graceful arcs handcarved by skilled craftspeople texture a mango wood circle divided into two mirror halves. The bleaching process brings out the rosy and grey tones of the wood, washing the diptych in warm, subtle color. Designed to be hung vertically, the two-part Dune bleached wood wall art is a Crate and Barrel exclusive.

items.name: "Ukiyo" by Huda Hashim 46.25" x 61.25" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Complement your decor with this print's soothing color and gentle abstraction. Named after the Japanese woodblock genre that translates to "pictures of the floating world," the work is a dreamy blend of layered textures and intuitive movement rendered in pastel washes and animated by dark daubs and feathery lines. The original acrylic painting is captured with all its nuance in our giclee print enhanced with hand-applied texture and presented in an oak-finished pine floater frame.

items.name: Hideaway 8"x10" Art Print
items.description_en: This nearly monochromatic image pays tribute to the quiet beauty of fresh snowfall. Overcast sky meets snow-covered ground at a horizon line of pale sage trees, sharing the composition with two humble dwellings. Hand-embellished with gel texture, the giclee print of the original acrylic painting is presented in a grey-finished wood frame accented with gold.

items.name: "Dark Modern Moment" 49"x81" Hand-Painted Raw Canvas Framed Wall Art
items.description_en: Graphic, impactful and absolutely one of a kind. This abstract artwork explores positive and negative space with boldly painted black shapes on a white field. Each work of art is hand painted on raw canvas and framed in a contemporary floater of blonde wood. Large-scale and dramatic, the painting looks amazing showcased on a prominent wall or stairwell. Due to its handcrafted nature, each painting is unique and will exhibit slight variations.

items.name: "Sense of Place" by Aliyah Sadaf Framed Wall Art
items.description_en: Summers in a sunbaked village in Pakistan inspired Aliyah Sadaf's monochromatic composition. Using a warm neutral palette, the artist recalls the town's concrete and clay buildings with a composition of four freeform rectangles that look like tightly wedged-together bricks. Each handpainted canvas replicates the original painting and is presented in a slim wood frame with an embossed grain finish.

items.name: "When Winter Begins" 49.5"x81.5" Hand-Painted Canvas Framed Wall Art
items.description_en: Textured grey forms flutter on a cloud of white to create an ethereal, abstract composition with a sense of motion and depth. Built-up layers and strategic negative space lend a misty atmosphere to the work. Painted by hand on canvas to showcase the natural fibers, our reproduction is presented in a wooden frame with a matte finish. When Winter Begins is a Crate and Barrel exclusive.

items.name: "White Block" 41"x51" Hand-Painted Canvas Framed Wall Art
items.description_en: Deeply textured brushstrokes create a painting with sculptural dimension. Talented artisans build up layers of gesso on a dreamy field of white paint to create a monochromatic yet fascinating work of art. The bare border of raw canvas shows off the natural fabric's fibers. Framed in a natural wood floater frame, White Block hangs vertically or horizontally to suit your space. Handpainted exclusively for Crate and Barrel, each modern painting is unique and subtle variations are expected.

items.name: "Bloom" by Kichael Bonofiglio Brown & Black Abstract 47"x50" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Kichael Bonofiglio uses color to tell stories and create work that is ever-changing but always modern. In "Bloom" washes of greys, browns, creams and greens punctuated with black layer an evocative composition. Beautiful in its abstraction, the large print suggests a portrait, a storm and more depending on your mood and perspective. This giclée print captures all of the textures and subtle hues of Bonofiglio's original acrylic painting and is presented in a natural wood frame.

items.name: "Hygge" by Huda Hashim 86.5"x51.5" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Complement your decor with this print's soothing color and gentle abstraction. The work revels in a rosy backdrop of mauve, purple and pink, animated by feathery black lines and daubs of deeper hues. The artist's aim is to put visual form to the Danish concept of "hygge"—a cozy, contemplative and comforting state—referred to in the title. The original acrylic painting is captured with all its nuance in our giclee print enhanced with hand-applied texture and framed in matte black-finished pine.

items.name: "Clear Conscience" by Joe Turner White Abstract Hand-Painted Framed Wall Art
items.description_en: Joe Turner transforms white paint into a sculptural work of art with surprising depth. Meandering curves—paths, rivers or thoughts, perhaps—intertwine, surrounded by dimensional crosshatches that create a rich surface. Painted by hand in thick acrylic paint on canvas, our reproduction captures the fascinating texture of the original. The long piece is presented in an understated wood floater frame that can be hung vertically or horizontally to suit your space and mood.

items.name: "Where the Walkway Meets Road" by Maggie Macdonald 31.5" x 41.5" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Maggie Macdonald uses loose brushstrokes and a vivid palette in this impressionist ode to wayside flowers. Against a grassy green and stoney blue backdrop springs a profusion of blooms in rose, purple, mauve, blue and gold. Hand-applied texture gives the giclee print the look of the original acrylic painting, while the hardwood frame complements with a gold finish.

items.name: "Cloud Meetings" by Lindsay Browning 50.5" x 34" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: This nearly abstract work establishes vaporous cloud cover and fog-enshrouded plains with soft brushstrokes and a unifying palette of misty greys with ocher accents. Our giclee print of the original acrylic painting is presented in a wood frame finished in espresso that lends definition to this dramatic and moody work of art.

items.name: "Lain I" Paper Mache Wall Art
items.description_en: Inspired by modernist sculpture, Alexis Gourguechon uses papier mache to create an abstract composition full of texture and dimension. The rounded geometric shapes produce a continuous array of shadow and highlights, making this wall art piece an eye-catching accent. The natural finish and varied grain of the ash wood box frame provides material contrast as well as organic warmth. We love it paired with its companion, "Lain II."

items.name: "Full of Hope" by Joe Turner Canvas 40"x50" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Bold, abstract and dynamic, this print brings gallery-like expression to your walls. A giclee print of Joe Turner's original acrylic painting, the composition's vivid brushwork, gestural drips and neutral palette look fresh from the easel thanks to textural hand-applied embellishment. Each print is presented under clear acrylic in a wood frame.

items.name: "Rock Landscape" by Sadie Byron 63.5" x 43.25" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: With a background in sculpture and floral design, artist Sadie Bryon brings an appreciation for form as well as nature's fluid beauty to this moody landscape. Simplified shapes give the structure to the rocky terrain, complemented by the nuanced brushwork used to create the cloud-blanketed sky. Originally painted in oils, this landscape is masterfully reproduced as a giclee print and presented in a wood frame finished in pewter. We love how the muted tones and soothing imagery create a calming moment in a hallway, bedroom or home office.

items.name: "Graze" by Kichael Bonofiglio Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Through a tangle of expressive lines a herd of cattle take shape in this evocative painting by Kichael Bonofiglio. While the linear network alludes to the herd's inherent animal energy, the tonal palette in soothing neutrals creates a sense of calm as the cows graze. Our giclee print on canvas beautifully captures the nuance and texture of the original mixed-media work made with oil pastels and heavy-body acrylic paint. An espresso-finished wood frame perfectly complements the work's earthy nature.

items.name: "Tuscany Village" 62"x42" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: The rolling Tuscan countryside comes alive with expressive color and dynamic mark making. The green foliage, brown earth and swirling clouds of the original painting are masterfully reproduced in our giclee print on watercolor paper. The print is presented under clear acrylic with a linen mat and oak-finished wood frame.

items.name: "Sweet Nostalgia" by Tessa Brown 40"x60" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: This imaginary landscape is rooted in the artist's memory of childhood romps. with a muted palette of brown, beige and green, the artist uses soft shapes and blended brushwork to suggest the fuzzy contours of remembered scenes. Our giclee reproduction captures all the nuances of the original work of art, presented under acrylic glass with an ivory mat and walnut-finished oak frame.

items.name: "Aspen" by Patrick St.Germain 41"x61" WhiteTextured Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: This striking work of art fascinates with texture. Capturing all of the subtleties and dynamic energy of Patrick St. Germain's mixed-media original, our exclusive reproduction was created by adhering sculptural arrangements of heavy white paper on a wooden base and handpainting it with matte white gesso. Monochromatic with ever-changing shadowplay, the resulting work of art evokes rumpled sheets, crumpled paper or snow-covered crags. We've presented "Aspen" in a slim white oak frame that hangs vertically or horizontally to suit your space.

items.name: "Ocean Breeze" by Lindsay Browning 48.5" x 48.5" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: This nearly abstract work establishes vaporous cloud cover, fog-enshrouded plains and shadow-darkened valleys with soft brushstrokes and a unifying palette of misty blues and greys. Our giclee print of the original acrylic painting is hand-finished with texture to give it a straight-from-the-studio appearance. A wood floater frame finished in gold lends definition to this dramatic and moody print.

items.name: "Polita" by Ksenia Sizaya 40"x50" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Inspired by Iceland's rock topography, Ksenia Sizaya used a mix of materials and layered application to give this abstract composition its captivating texture. Sculpting a base layer, she added pigment in soft brown hues to give the tactile piece a warm, earthy look. Based on the original mixed-media composition, each handcrafted work is made with a mix of acrylic paint and modeling paste that's scraped, combed and brushed to give the work dimension and texture. A foil-wrapped wood floating frame complements for a gallery-worthy presentation.

items.name: Night Bouquet 8"x10" Art Print
items.description_en: Broad brushstrokes and moody shadows lend drama to our Night Bouquet painting. Pinpointed illumination highlights the dark grey vase, garnet roses and pale green foliage, dissolving the rest of the floral arrangement into deep shadow. The giclee print of the original painting presented in a molded wood frame finished in reddish-brown.

items.name: "Meet you There" by Sadie Byron 31" x 41" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: In this pensive landscape, artist Sadie Byron uses a palette of muted grays and green to recreate the fading foliage and quiet mood that accompanies the transition from late summer into fall. Loosely brushed with softened forms, the work has the look and feel of a remembered scene. Our giclee print on canvas captures the texture and nuanced color of the original oil painting and is complemented by a pine wood frame finished in black and gold.

items.name: "Peace Like a River No. 3" by Hannah Winters 48"x36" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: In creating this landscape, Hannah Winters imagined making her way through dense brush and the sense of calm she would feel spying this gentle river in the clearing. Subtle coloring and softened brushstrokes give this work its dreamlike quality and the misty atmosphere that seems to merge clouds with ground. Our giclee print captures all the nuance of the original oil painting and is presented in a distressed pine frame finished in black.

items.name: "Under the Moon" by Karen Parisian 64.7"x32.7" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Composed of simple curves of positive and negative space, a stylized figure reclines under a full moon in this striking work of art. Our handpainted giclee print captures the texture and layering found in the original painting, and a walnut-finished wood frame brings its soothing neutral palette into focus. The large, horizontal print is perfect for bringing a contemporary accent into a living or dining room.

items.name: "Scatter" by Kichael Bonofiglio 81.75"x51.75" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Unfettered by a planned palette or preliminary sketch, Kichael Bonofiglio embraced unrestricted creativity in "Scatter." A tangle of expressive and unplanned brushwork gives the work its raw edge and energy. Our giclee print on canvas of the original acrylic painting is hand-embellished with additional texture to give it a fresh-off-the-easel look. A sustainably sourced pine frame is finished in walnut to bring out the work's earthy palette.

items.name: "Composition of Neutrals" Reproduction 75"x55" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Abstract shapes in grey, taupe, white and black structure a neutral patchwork in our exclusive giclée reproduction. Added paint and layered tissue provide dimension and texture similar to the original mixed-media composition. For a gallery-worthy display, we've installed the print in a slim black floater frame. With its subdued palette and intriguing shapes, this print complements any modern room with its contemporary aesthetic.

items.name: "If You Could Read My Mind" by Karen Parisian 30.5"x59.5" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Block-like shapes engage in a geometric dialogue in this abstract yet evocative composition. Rendered in tonal greys, tan and ocher, our handpainted giclee print brilliantly captures the bold forms and subtle coloring of the original painting. Each print is presented in a grey-finished wood frame. We love its contemporary look and the pop of color it provides while still maintaining a decor-friendly neutral palette.

items.name: "Allegra" by Sadie Byron 19"x26" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Artist Sadie Bryon brings her experience as both a sculptor and a floral designer to this delightful still life. Simplified shapes, expressive brushwork and an up-close vantage point underscore the lush forms and vibrancy of a vase brimming with foliage and flowers in full bloom. Originally painted in oils, this charming still life is reproduced as a giclee print and presented in a wood frame finished with silver leaf.

items.name: "Silent Passage I" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: A study in blue and sculptural forms, this enigmatic artwork is abstract yet evocative. A central white shape is modeled with human-like proportions and seems to stand or recline depending on whether the work is hung vertically or horizontally. Our giclee print on canvas captures the brushwork and tonal nuance of the original painting. Hand-applied texture gives the artwork a fresh-from-the-easel appearance, and a walnut-finished ash floater frame provides a warm accent to the cool-toned palette.

items.name: "Blueprint" by Huda Hashim 54" x 54" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: The color blue in all its mesmerizing, evocative splendor is the focus of this abstract composition by Huda Hashim. Hanging vertically or horizontally, the piece complements your walls with modern style and rich tonal color. Hand-applied texture gives the giclee print the look of the original acrylic painting, while the hardwood frame accents with a gold finish.

items.name: "ColorWave" by Joe Turner Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Bold, abstract and dynamic, this print brings gallery-like expression to your walls. A giclee print of Joe Turner's original acrylic painting, the composition's vivid brushwork, gestural marks and color-infused palette look fresh from the easel thanks to textural hand-applied embellishment. Each print is presented in a floater frame made of hardwood finished in walnut.

items.name: "Belle Epoque" by Sadie Byron 21" x 23" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Sadie Bryon brings her experience as both a sculptor and a floral designer to this delightful still life. Simplified shapes, expressive brushwork and an up-close vantage point underscore the lush forms and subtle coloring of the Belle Epoque tulips, the artist's favorite variety. Originally painted in oils, this charming still life is reproduced as a giclee print and presented in a wood frame finished in gold.

items.name: Nest by Patrick St. Germain 40" x 50" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Fascinated by remnants of past civilizations visible in the ruins on an island in Crete, artist Patrick St. Germain created this evocatively abstract work of art. The artist used gel to give the piece texture, layering in acrylic paint, charcoal and washes of white for added depth. Each handpainted canvas displayed in a hardwood floating frame expertly recreates the dynamic composition and textural richness of the original mixed-media painting.

items.name: Mallorca by Jimmy Thompson 26" x 32" Wall Art Print
items.description_en: With whimsy and an illustrator's eye, Jimmy Thompson captures the picturesque coves and rocky terrain of Mallorca's coastline in this breezy rendering. The image takes inspiration from vintage travel posters, loosely brushed in lush watercolor tones with the location name noted in flowing script. Our giclee print reproduces the vivid color and vibrant energy of the original. Each poster comes rolled in a tube, ready to be framed.

items.name: Sea Cliffs by Hope Bainbridge 49" x 65" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Inspired by Japanese screen painting, Hope Bainbridge created this misty seascape by layering watery washes of paint in a soothing palette. Our giclee print on raw canvas beautifully captures the tonal depth and tranquil feel of the original acrylic painting. Presented in a hardwood frame finished in espresso brown, the print graces an entryway or living room wall with muted color and a peaceful presence.

items.name: "Seaside" by Eric Muhr Black and White Photograph 40"x60" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Depicting a spot where forest meets ocean, Eric Muhr focused his lens on this dramatic cliffside. The image explores the full range of black-and-white photography, from the deep blacks of the rocky shadows to the white surf and mid-greys of the sea. Each print is presented in a whitewash wood frame under acrylic glass for a clean, modern look.

items.name: "Let's Walk The Path" by Lindsay Browning 54" x 40" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Lindsay Browning's fanciful landscape invites viewers to partake in a scene both witnessed and imagined. Freely drawn flowers, birds and greenery populate a misty setting, rendered in softly brushed and blended neutrals with a hint of blue. Our giclee print of the original acrylic painting is hand-finished with texture to give it a straight-from-the-studio appearance. A wood floater frame finished in gold lends definition to this dreamy scene.

items.name: "Further Woodland" by Beverly Fuller Large Reproduction 41"x55" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: A sense of nostalgia and the solitude of the woods permeate Beverly Fuller's sensitively rendered watercolor painting. Recalling the graying sky and last rays of a setting sun, she recorded the colors and mood of the moment with delicate pencil marks and pale washes. Our large giclée print faithfully reproduces all the detail and nuance of the acrylic original. A slim matte black frame and a single white mat put the focus on this extraordinary image. Beverly Fuller holds a bachelor of arts degree from Whittier College and a master of arts from California State University in Los Angeles. After completing her education, she engaged in a creative journey around the U.S. that inspired her to become a full-time painter. Fuller lives and works in Northern California.

items.name: "Campo De Lava" by Marcela Gutierrez 60"x48" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Inspired by the rugged terrain of a cooled lava flow, Marcela Gutierrez creates a textured landscape using papier mache, soil and paint to give this monochromatic painting its dramatic intensity. Based on the original mixed-media composition, each one-of-a-kind work or art is crafted by hand with a mix of paper pulp, sand gel and acrylic paint. A wood frame wrapped in antique bronze complements for a gallery-worthy presentation.

items.name: Bondi Beach by Jimmy Thompson 26" x 32" Wall Art Print
items.description_en: With whimsy and an illustrator's eye, Jimmy Thompson captures the golden sands and bustling atmosphere of Bondi Beach in this breezy rendering. The image takes inspiration from vintage travel posters, loosely brushed in lush watercolor tones with the location name noted in flowing script. Our giclee print reproduces the vivid color and vibrant energy of the original. Each poster comes rolled in a tube, ready to be framed.

items.name: "As it Was" by Kichael Bonofiglio 44.5"x44.5" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Recalling her childhood as a quiet girl who enjoyed her time alone, Kichael Bonofiglio depicts solitude as a source of self-discovery in this evocative work. Seated against an abstract backdrop of broadly brushed swathes of neutral color, the figure seems caught in a private moment with feathery white lines suggesting the psychic energy of her thoughts. Our giclee print on canvas of the original acrylic painting is hand-embellished with additional texture to give it a fresh-off-the-easel look.

items.name: "Reverence" by Aliyah Sadaf for Athena Calderone 48"x60" Canvas Art Print
items.description_en: A fan of Aliyah Sadaf's organic aesthetic, Athena Calderone invited the artist to create artworks that capture the spirit of the designer's collection. Nuanced brown tones and a floating quadrilateral give the abstract work an ethereal quality. items.name: "Dormancy" by Sadie Byron 55" x 45" Framed Wall Art Print

We love how the muted tones and soothing imagery create a calming moment in a hallway, bedroom or home office.

items.name: "Lava Rock" by Ruby 55" x 55" Framed Wall Art Print
items.description_en: Moody and abstract, "Lava Rock" elevates your living space with art gallery vibes. Based on the original mixed-media composition, each one-of-a-kind work or art is handpainted by talented artists. A foil-wrapped wood frame complements for a gallery-worthy presentation.

Set against an atmospheric backdrop of grey tones, the subject is a rustic, organically shaped vase filled with a bare yet expressively branched stem. Each print is framed in silver-finished wood and hand-embellished with texture for a fresh-from-the-easel look.

items.name: Riverside Semi Circles & Sutton Arches Wall Art Tiles Set of 6

items.name: "Repose Print" by David Erickson 46.5"x46.5" Framed Wall Art Print

The mirror can be mounted on the wall horizontally or vertically and is safe to hang in the bathroom. Part of our exclusive Edge collection, which includes round, rectangular and arched floor and wall mirrors in a modern mix of metals.

items.name: Edge Brass Metal Wide Depth Wall Mirror 19"x42"
items.description_en: Our bestselling Edge mirror collection gets a new dramatic depth. Edged with a wide ribbon of gold, this minimalist wall mirror curves a bold rounded rectangle. The mirror hangs on the wall vertically or horizontally, its deep brass-finished stainless steel frame doubling as a shelf—providing a spot to display small decorative pieces or hold cosmetics as you get ready. With its modern, graphic presence, the gleaming mirror serves as jewelry for your walls while brightening the space. Group with our other Edge mirrors in contrasting or coordinating shapes and finishes to create an intriguing geometric display.

items.name: Emmy Wood Wall Mirror 36" x 40"
items.description_en: Our Emmy wall mirror reimagines the classic Tudor arch, right in your modern home. Also called a four-centered arch, this elegant shape adds subtle architectural interest to the wall mirror's simple linear frame of brown-finished acacia wood. Perfectly proportioned to fit over a fireplace mantel, the wall mirror also lends light-reflecting brightness to an entryway, powder room or bath.

items.name: Kensington Black Oak Wood Round Wall Mirror 40"
items.description_en: Inspired by Scandinavian architecture, our Kensington wall mirror showcases exquisite simplicity. Concentric carvings in the oak frame emphasize the round silhouette while creating depth in the black-finished wood. Timeless and understated, Kensington instantly adds Scandi style to your decor.

items.name: Edge Black Rounded Rectangle Vanity Mirror 36"x24"
items.description_en: Edged with a slim black band, this minimalist wall mirror curves rounded rectangle for a modern and elegant silhouette. The mirror can be mounted on the wall horizontally or vertically and is safe to hang in the bathroom.

items.name: Amelie Antique Brass Mantel Mirror 39.5" x 36"
items.description_en: Scaled to complement a fireplace mantel, credenza or double-sink vanity, the Amelie wall mirror dresses rooms with classic lines and vintage charm. Made of aluminum, the detailed frame pays homage to traditional French mirrors with ogee curves and molded texture. Hand-finished edges enhance the glow of the gold-leaf finish, catching and reflecting light to brighten your space.

items.name: Edge Medium Black Rectangle Vanity Mirror 24"x36"
items.description_en: Edged with a slim gunmetal band, this rectangular wall mirror shapes a modern and minimalist silhouette. Beveled mirrored glass is bordered by a slender stainless steel frame with a dark finish. The rectangle mirror can be mounted on the wall horizontally or vertically and is ideal for hanging in an entryway, in the bathl or above a dresser in the bedroom.

items.name: Edge Medium Silver Rectangle Vanity Mirror 24"x36"
items.description_en: Edged with a slim brushed nickel band, this rectangular wall mirror shapes a modern and minimalist silhouette. Beveled mirrored glass is bordered by a slender stainless steel frame with a cool, silvery finish. The rectangle mirror can be mounted on the wall horizontally or vertically and is ideal for hanging in an entryway, in the bath or above a dresser in the bedroom.

items.name: Aimee Antique Brass Wall Mirror 34" x 40"
items.description_en: The Aimee mirror imbues contemporary form with timeless elegance. A slim frame of hand-forged iron traces Aimee's fluid asymmetrical curves, adding character and texture to the sleek contours. An antique brass finish defines the shape while adding a hint of glitz.

items.name: Edge Silver Arch Wall Mirror 36"x34"
items.description_en: Edged with a slim band of silver, this minimalist wall mirror curves a subtle arch of modern elegance. Beveled mirrored glass is bordered by slim stainless steel with a nickel finish. This mirror can be mounted on the wall vertically or horizontally and is safe to hang in bathrooms.

items.name: Marguerite Antique Brass Wall Mirror 20" x 29.75"
items.description_en: With clean styling and a touch of tradition, Marguerite finesses Old World charm for contemporary interiors. Made of iron with an antique brass finish, the wall mirror tops its rectangular form with an arched crown. Channel molding lends dimension and definition for a look that's equally at home in classic, modern or transitional settings.

items.name: Intarsia Off-White Bone & Resin Round Wall Mirror
items.description_en: Classic yet contemporary, this striking wall mirror captures the eye with a round frame made of inlaid bone and resin. True to the tradition of intarsia—the time-honored technique of fitting together bits of wood in a mosaic-like design—skilled craftspeople inlay triangles of hand-cut wood and bone to frame the mirror in artisanal charm.

items.name: Emmy Wood Vanity Mirror 24"x36"
items.description_en: Our Emmy vanity mirror reimagines the classic Tudor arch, right in your modern home. Also called a four-centered arch, this elegant shape adds subtle architectural interest to the wall mirror's simple linear frame of brown-finished acacia wood. A lovely way to add definition and provide light-reflecting brightness to an entryway, powder room or bath, the Emmy wood wall mirror is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Harris White Boucle Round Wall Mirror 45"
items.description_en: Inspired by some of our favorite furniture pieces, we've upholstered a mirror for an unexpected look. Harris wraps a classic round wall mirror in white boucle, encircling reflections in softness. Irresistibly nubby, the textural fabric brings an organic warmth to the wall. The double-frame structure is a subtle design detail that adds dimension and depth. We especially love this mirror in a room decorated with one of our boucle chairs, sofas or throw pillows.

items.name: Edge Brass Round Wall Mirror 36"
items.description_en: Edged with a slim brass band, this modern and minimalist wall mirror curves an elegant circle. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, its reflective beveled glass creates a subtle series of concentric circles with delicate appeal. With its brass-finish stainless steel frame, the round wall mirror is an understated essential in the entryway, bedroom or stairway landing. Arrange with our Edge arch, capsule, and rounded rectangle floor and wall mirrors in gunmetal, brushed nickel and brass to create an intriguing geometric display.

items.name: Edge Brass Rectangle Wall Mirror 24"x36"
items.description_en: Edged with a slim brass band, this rectangular wall mirror shapes a modern and minimalist silhouette. Beveled mirrored glass is bordered by a slender stainless steel frame with a gleaming brass finish. The rectangle mirror can be mounted on the wall horizontally or vertically and is ideal for hanging in an entryway, in the bath or above a dresser in the bedroom.
