With its modern, graphic presence, the mirror serves as jewelry for your walls while brightening the space. Group with our other Edge mirrors in contrasting or coordinating shapes and finishes to create an intriguing geometric display.

items.name: Edge Black Arch Wall Mirror 36"x34"
items.description_en: Edged with a slim black band, this minimalist wall mirror curves a subtle arch of modern elegance. With its black-finished stainless steel frame, the arched wall mirror is an understated essential in any room and is safe to hang in bathrooms. Group with our Edge round, capsule, and rounded rectangle floor and wall mirrors in silver, brass and black to create an intriguing geometric display.

items.name: Edge Black Round Wall Mirror 36"
items.description_en: Edged with a slim black band, this minimalist and modern wall mirror curves an elegant circle. A Crate & Barrel exclusive, its reflective beveled glass creates a subtle series of concentric circles with delicate appeal. With its black-finished stainless steel frame, the round wall mirror is an understated essential in the bedroom, entryway or bathroom. Arrange with our Edge arch, capsule, and rounded rectangle floor and wall mirrors in gunmetal, brushed nickel and brass to create an intriguing geometric display.

items.name: Manor Black Wood Wall Mirror 43"x41"
items.description_en: Our Manor wall mirror streamlines a traditional silhouette—tapered rectangle topped with swooping shield curves—into a modern accent piece. Crafted of renewable solid mango wood from trees no longer producing fruit, the carved frame is finished in black to add graphic punch. The versatile, timeless design has a strong presence hung above a console table, buffet or loveseat.

items.name: Portal Suede Vanity Mirror by Laura Harrier and Tiffany Howell
items.description_en: Inspired by the sumptuous interior of a vintage sportscar, this suede vanity mirror embodies understated luxury. Sustainably sourced wood shapes a slender oval with a bullnose profile. Detailed with monochromatic whipstitching, caramel suede wraps the frame for a look that's warm and organic yet totally indulgent. This wall mirror instantly adds '70s glam over a vanity, dresser or entryway console. Enter a world of elegance, romance and fashion with our exclusive new collection created in collaboration with designer Tiffany Howell and actor Laura Harrier.

items.name: Mael Antique Brass Wall Mirror 30" x 34"
items.description_en: Linear and luxe, our Mael mirror invests pure geometry with modern style and the allure of antique brass. The ultra-thin iron frame widens at the base with a bold border, its horizontal emphasis echoed by the slim rod at the top from which the mirror seems suspended. The wall mirror is a contemporary classic that's ideal for living rooms, entryways and bathrooms.

items.name: Marguerite Iron Wall Mirror 20" x 29.75"
items.description_en: With clean styling and a touch of tradition, Marguerite finesses Old World charm for contemporary interiors. Made of iron with a dark rustic finish, the wall mirror tops its rectangular form with an arched crown. Channel molding lends dimension and definition for a look that's equally at home in classic, modern or transitional settings.

items.name: Edge Silver Round Wall Mirror 30"
items.description_en: Edged with a slim band of silver, this minimalist wall mirror curves a modern and elegant circle. Its reflective beveled glass creates a subtle series of concentric circles with delicate interest. With its nickel-finish stainless steel frame, the round wall mirror is an understated essential in any room and is safe to hang in bathrooms. Group with our Edge arch, capsule, and rounded rectangle mirrors in brass, brushed nickel and gunmetal to create an intriguing geometric display.

items.name: Edge Black Arch Entryway Wall Mirror 24"x36"
items.description_en: Our Edge mirror brightens your entryway with reflected light, while four hooks and a slim ledge provide the perfect spot for keys, sunglasses, dog leashes and other out-the-door essentials. We love the way it makes the most of even the smallest entryways, offering organization, a sense of space and sleek style. Edged with a slim stainless band finished in black, the minimalist wall mirror curves a subtle arch of modern elegance. Our exclusive Edge collection includes mirrors ideal for bathrooms, bedrooms, above mantels and more.

items.name: Mael Antique Black Wall Mirror 30" x 34"
items.description_en: Linear and luxe, the Mael mirror invests pure geometry with modern style and a vintage-inspired black finish. The ultra-thin iron frame widens at the base with a bold border, its horizontal emphasis echoed by the slim rod at the top from which the mirror seems suspended. The wall mirror is a contemporary classic that's ideal for living rooms, entryways and bathrooms.

items.name: Amelie Brass Vanity Mirror 22" x 26"
items.description_en: The Amelie wall mirror dresses hallways, living rooms and baths with classic lines and vintage charm. Made of aluminum, the detailed frame pays homage to traditional French mirrors with ogee curves and molded texture. Hand-finished edges enhance the glow of the gold-leaf finish, catching and reflecting light to brighten your space.

items.name: Elisabeth Wood Mantel Mirror 48" x 32"
items.description_en: Scaled to complement a fireplace mantel or credenza, the Elisabeth mirror makes a statement with contemporary form and the warmth of natural wood. A deceptively simple mango wood frame traces the curvilinear design, expertly crafted with bullnose edges, rounded corners and a subtly arched base. An aged brown finish highlights the grain, adding depth and organic richness to the sophisticated design.

items.name: Keane Natural Wood Round Wall Mirror
items.description_en: The perfect companion to our bestselling Keane collection, this handsome wall mirror streamlines a modern classic in natural-finished mahogany. An inlaid metallic rim finished in golden brass and definition to the frame along with light-reflecting sparkle. Architectural lines and a casual vibe, make this round mirror a great accent piece in an entry room, living room or bedroom.

items.name: Blanche Brass Convex Wall Mirror 46.5"
items.description_en: Give your room a captivating focal point with Blanche. Set within a slim round iron frame with an antique brass finish, the oversized convex mirror provides an intriguing wide-angle reflection of your space. The convex shape naturally amplifies light, making the wall mirror a great choice to help small or dark rooms feel brighter and more open.

items.name: Blanche Black Convex Wall Mirror 46.5"
items.description_en: Give your room a captivating focal point with Blanche. Set within a slim round iron frame with a matte black finish, the oversized convex mirror provides an intriguing wide-angle reflection of your space. The convex shape naturally amplifies light, making the wall mirror a great choice to help small or dark rooms feel brighter and more open.

items.name: Jenny Lind Deep Brown Wood 30" Round Kids Wall Mirror
items.description_en: A bestseller for a reason, our Jenny Lind collection is a showstopper in any space—and those iconic wood turnings look every bit as striking on the wall. The intricate shapes and deep brown finish of our round wall mirror suit nearly any room in the home, though we're partial to coordinating it with our Jenny Lind beds, cribs and dressers. Fun fact: This forever classic is named for the 19th century opera singer Jenny Lind, who was the pop icon and influencer of her day.

items.name: Tuscan Beige Marble Trash Can
items.description_en: Inspired by the rustic warmth and organic beauty of central Italy, our Tuscan collection showcases softly neutral yet statement-making beige marble. The gorgeous, practical accessories outfit a unified powder room, guest bath or en suite that's ready for hosting. This trash can elevates a bathroom essential and fits perfectly in a corner. Honed to a modern matte finish, each waste basket fascinates with subtle variations in hue, texture and veining.

items.name: Bleecker Black Marble Trash Can
items.description_en: Our Bleecker collection brings the dramatic beauty of black marble to your powder room, guest bath or en suite. Sleek, modern lines keep all the focus on the stone's intriguing grey and white streaks. Cut with crisp corners, this waste basket has a strong presence. Add our other gorgeous-yet-practical Bleecker accessories for a unified bathroom that's ready for hosting. Due to the natural marble, each trash can is fascinatingly unique.

items.name: Carmen Fluted White Marble Trash Can
items.description_en: Luxurious in white marble, our Carmen collection outfits your bathroom in classical style. The delicate fluting creates a soft, light look that contrasts with the heavy stone. Squared off to fit in a corner, this waste basket has a stately presence. The Carmen collection upgrades any powder room, guest bath or en suite—and especially suits our marble-topped vanities. Due to the natural marble, each trash can is beautifully unique.

items.name: Blomus SONO 1.3-Gallon Moonbeam Cream Pedal Trash Bin
items.description_en: The Blomus SONO bathroom collection brings together gentle shapes coated in soft silicone that mix and match beautifully. Crafted with rounded edges and a silky matte cream finish, this trash bin opens smoothly with a step on its petite pedal. The trash bin looks modern and understated on a vanity or bath surround, complementing your bathroom decor whether on its own or paired with coordinating pieces in the collection.

items.name: Varick Blue Silicone Coated Trash Can
items.description_en: Our Varick bathroom collection dips sturdy ceramic in soft-touch silicone that feels soft and luxurious. The gentle, minimalist curves and compact scale suit even the smallest powder room, guest bath or en suite. Subtly tinted in a modern shade of light grey-blue, this tonal trash can pairs a matte exterior with a glossy interior finish. Outfit bathrooms in all of our Varick accessories to create serene sanctuaries that are ready for company.

items.name: Varick White Silicone Coated Trash Can
items.description_en: Our Varick bathroom collection dips sturdy ceramic in white soft-touch silicone that feels soft and luxurious. The gentle, minimalist curves and compact scale suit even the smallest powder room, guest bath or en suite. This tonal trash can pairs a matte exterior with a glossy interior finish. Outfit bathrooms in all of our Varick accessories to create serene sanctuaries that are ready for company.

items.name: Sedona White Lidded Rectangular Tote
items.description_en: Bringing together the modern and the traditional, a community of weavers combine warmly hued rattan and bright white strands to create our clean-lined Sedona lidded rectangular tote. The mix of colors and materials gives a fresh feel to the clean, lidded cylinder, handwoven using a tight-coiling hapao technique. Ideal for storing washcloths, toiletries for guests or up to three rolls of toilet paper, our white lidded bin is part of our exclusive Sedona storage collection. Each handmade piece will vary slightly in size. Check out our storage ideas for your bathroom .

items.name: Blomus Wilo Wood Trash Cans
items.description_en: Sustainably sourced oak transforms household storage into a work of natural beauty. Simply designed as a gently tapered cylinder, this wastebasket showcases the dramatic grain and warm color variations of natural hardwood. The round bin joins with other Wilo accessories to give bathrooms, offices or living rooms a look that's clean-lined and organically expressive. A fifth-generation family company, Blomus is based in Germany and well-known for its strong function-meets-form product line of accessories for the home.

items.name: Sedona Honey Lidded Rectangular Tote
items.description_en: A honey finish warms up this clean, lidded cylinder of rattan and buri, handwoven using a tight-coiling hapao technique. Each handmade piece will vary slightly in size. Check out our storage ideas for your bathroom .

items.name: Sedona Honey Totes
items.description_en: Warm honey-brown rattan is handwoven into a sturdy open shape with rounded corners and cutout bin handles finished with wrap detail. One of two larger nesting sizes or low tote. Each handmade piece will vary slightly in size.

items.name: Sedona White Totes
items.description_en: Handwoven of sturdy rattan and finished in white lacquer, our Sedona large storage tote brings loads of texture to bathroom storage. Rectangular with rounded corners, the roomy tote has cutout handles with wrap detail to make it easy to access and transport. Complete the look with our other Sedona white bath accessories. Due to Sedona's handcrafted nature, each tote will be slightly unique. Available in large and small sizes, the totes are so great for storing gloves and scarves in the entryway or keeping home office supplies looking neat and tidy.

items.name: Blomus SONO 1.3-Gallon Black Pedal Trash Bin
items.description_en: The Blomus SONO bathroom collection brings together gentle shapes coated in soft silicone that mix and match beautifully. Crafted with rounded edges and a silky matte black finish, this trash bin opens smoothly with a step on its petite pedal. The trash bin looks modern and understated on a vanity or bath surround, complementing your bathroom decor whether on its own or paired with coordinating pieces in the collection.

items.name: Sedona Grey Totes
items.description_en: Sedona storage offers loads of texture, handwoven of sturdy rattan and finished in warm grey. Rounded tote has cutout handles with wrap detail to stow in bath, bedroom or office. Each handmade piece will vary slightly in size.

items.name: Joseph Joseph EasyStore 5L Pedal Trash Bin with Liner Storage - White
items.description_en: This thoughtfully designed waste bin is perfectly proportioned for bathrooms, bedrooms and home offices. Crafted of durable stainless steel with a white gloss finish, the sleek trash can shapes a pleasantly rounded triangle that fits snugly into corners. The sturdy pedal opens the brushed stainless steel lid, which closes softly every time. Fitted with a removable inner bucket for easy emptying, the small bin also boasts a hidden on the back that holds a spare roll of liner bags.

items.name: Palmer Raffia Decorative Storage Box
items.description_en: Our coastal chic Palmer collection keeps essentials organized while maintaining a laid-back, breezy look. Painted by hand before being wrapped entirely in raffia—the fiber of the raffia palm tree—this hinged box has a refined look in a warm, sandy hue. The tonal linen-lined interior cradles remote controls on the coffee table, sunglasses on the entryway console, or love letters on the dresser. Pair the large wooden box with the other Palmer storage pieces for organization with seaside style.

items.name: Alford Rattan Rectangle Baskets
items.description_en: Our versatile Alford collection now includes display-worthy storage options to keep all of your essentials corralled in style. Stained golden honey-brown, natural rattan is handwoven by skilled craftspeople into a large rectangular basket perfectly sized for throw pillows, blankets or plush toys. Cutout handles help tote the bin from room to room, while braided accents emphasize the basket's artisanship and elevated organic beauty. Combine with our other woven Alford pieces for a new take on a timeless classic.

items.name: Alford Rattan Square Basket
items.description_en: Our versatile Alford wicker collection now includes display-worthy storage options to keep all of your essentials corralled in style. Stained golden honey-brown, natural rattan is handwoven by skilled craftspeople into a square basket perfectly sized for plush toys in the living room or hats and gloves in the coat closet. Cutout handles help tote the bin from room to room, while braided accents emphasize the basket's artisanship and elevated organic beauty. Combine with our other woven Alford pieces for a new take on a timeless classic.

items.name: Steele ® Tall Black Canvas Storage and Laundry Basket
items.description_en: Renowned for its industrial-style laundry carts, Steele Canvas Basket Co. tackles household storage with this tall black canvas basket. The soft-sided basket is made with sturdy duck canvas and double-reinforced webbing handles. Taking up a small footprint, the basket rises tall to maximize storage. Great for toting laundry, the storage bin also corrals sporting equipment, throws and other household items.

items.name: SortJoy Wide Stone Sculpted Storage Bin
items.description_en: Storage with a touch of softness. This felt storage bin crafted with recycled polyester corrals everything from guest slippers to picture books to cold-weather accessories. We appreciate the display-worthy bin's structured sturdiness and clean, sculpted curves in any room of the house. The warm stone hue showcases unique subtleties and harmonizes effortlessly with modern decor. Useful on its own, the wide bin organizes beautifully in multiples on open shelving, in a linen closet or under an entryway bench.

items.name: Alford Rattan Trunk with Lid
items.description_en: Our versatile Alford wicker collection now includes display-worthy storage options to keep all of your essentials corralled in style. Stained golden honey-brown, natural rattan is handwoven by skilled craftspeople into a trunk perfectly sized for throw pillows, extra towels or off-season clothing. Cutout handles help tote the lidded basket from room to room, while braided accents emphasize the trunk's artisanship and elevated organic beauty. Combine with our other woven Alford pieces for a new take on a timeless classic.

items.name: Decorative Gold Holiday Bells
items.description_en: We've scaled up a classic to ring in the holiday season. Gleaming in high-shine gold, our oversized bell with its luxe velvet bow fits effortlessly into your Christmas decor. We love the look of it standing on a fireplace mantel, scattered down a dining table or hung from a ribbon—and the more bells, the better.

items.name: Cotswold White Ceramic Village Collection
items.description_en: Our snow-white ceramic church was inspired by the countryside charm of the Cotswolds. The delightful details embody the cozy sophistication of the region, while the handpainted white finish and clean, linear style suit modern winter decor. When filled with a tealight, a warm glow spills through the cutout windows for the inviting look of a snug, light-filled sanctuary. Style with our other exclusive stoneware buildings to create a Cotswold-inspired village on your mantel, buffet or dining room table.

items.name: Brass Bell Holiday Door Swag
items.description_en: Ring in the Christmas season with the joyous sound of bells. Painted with a vintage brass finish, five bells with slim, elongated clappers cluster on red velvet ribbon that's sewn and knotted by hand. The door swag adds a luxe, classic Christmas look to a wreath, banister or interior door.

items.name: Faux Cypress and Red Berry Holiday Stem 40"
items.description_en: Our faux stem masterfully recreates the deep green color and feathery look of cypress. Dotted with small red berries, the stem accents the home with wintry elegance, presented on its own in a vase, grouped in multiples or arranged with our other artificial botanicals.

items.name: Zinc Holiday Decorative Reindeers
items.description_en: Crafted by hand with a modern, abstracted silhouette, flowing curves and a dark zinc finish, our reindeer sculpture gazes at the winter landscape, searching for lichen, moss and ferns to nibble. The caribou's elongated legs and rounded cuteness add a playful element to holiday decor. Group with our other exclusive reindeer sculptures to create a miniature herd on your fireplace mantel, buffet or dining room table—for an extra touch of wintry wonder, sprinkle the scene with fluffy faux snow. The zinc reindeer is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Faux Red Amaryllis and Berry Holiday Bouquet
items.description_en: Just pop our fool-the-eye bouquet into a vase for instant holiday color. Made to last season after season, the faux arrangement gathers together a variety of seasonal greenery, lifelike berries and brilliant red amaryllis blooms.

items.name: Faux Hemlock Pre-Lit Holiday Stem 40"
items.description_en: Our pre-lit hemlock stem instantly brightens your holiday decor with sparkling lights and the magic of the winter landscape. Unparalleled in quality and skillfully crafted to look just like the real thing, our faux stem recreates hemlock's dark green color and lacy boughs. Starry warm white lights stud the lifelike botanical, with the timer function offering easy evening illumination. Add the battery-powered branch to an artificial Christmas arrangement to add illumination, or group multiple hemlock stems in a vase for a lush display.

items.name: Decorative Silver Holiday Bells
items.description_en: We've scaled up a classic to ring in the holiday season. Adorned with a luxe velvet ribbon, our oversized, high-shine silver bell fits effortlessly into your Christmas decor. We love the look of it standing on a fireplace mantel, scattered down a dining table or hung from a ribbon—and the more bells, the better.

items.name: Faux Pine Needle and Pinecone Holiday Stem 38"
items.description_en: Create instant holiday ambiance with one or a handful of our faux pine stems. Recreating the feathery needles and silvery-sage color of natural pine, our lifelike stem is studded with actual pinecones for a look that's natural and organic. Lovely in one of our clear glass or earthenware vases, the pine stem adds seasonal greenery that lasts from year to year.

items.name: Madeira Walnut Wood Decorative Turned Trees
items.description_en: Reminiscent of midcentury-modern wood sculptures, our Madeira trees have stately silhouettes with plenty of presence. The simple fluted carving adds depth while keeping all the attention on the gorgeously grained acacia wood. Hand-finished in rich walnut for a warm, organic look, the large evergreen mixes and matches effortlessly with the other wood, glass, ceramic and metal trees in our winter collection.

items.name: Aspen Village Holiday Advent Calendar
items.description_en: Count down to Christmas with our showstopping advent calendar. Crafted of handpainted wood, the reusable calendar tops a long case of mini drawers with a picturesque mountain village. Sparkling snow tops evergreen trees and charming gingerbread houses, while revelers ski and sled. Lights in all of the buildings cast a cozy glow—simply turn on the timer to illuminate them automatically every night throughout the month. A gorgeous decor piece to look forward to using every holiday season, our exclusive Aspen village advent calendar offers 24 drawers that can be filled with treats and tiny toys.

items.name: Faux Blue Spruce Holiday Stem 42"
items.description_en: Our lifelike stem recreates the crisp needles and silvery-blue color of blue spruce. Presented on its own in a vase, grouped in multiples or arranged with our other artificial botanicals, the tall stem graces your home with wintery elegance.

items.name: Faux White Amaryllis and Greenery Holiday Bouquet
items.description_en: Just pop our fool-the-eye bouquet into a vase for instant holiday color. Made to last season after season, the faux arrangement gathers together a variety of seasonal greenery and lush white amaryllis blooms.

items.name: Faux Magnolia and Berry Holiday Bunch 16"
items.description_en: Enjoy the fleeting beauty of blooms in the depths of winter with our faux holiday bunch. Unparalleled in quality and skillfully crafted to look just like the real thing, the bouquet combines bright red berries and blue-green eucalyptus with magnolia's snow-white blossoms and glossy, deep green leaves. Instantly add Christmas cheer to your decor by popping the artificial arrangement in one of our artisanal or ultra-modern vases.

items.name: Faux Red Mini Berry Holiday Stem 48"
items.description_en: Clusters of tiny red berries dot this delightfully realistic faux stem. Lovely popped in a clear glass or ceramic vase, the fool-the-eye branch decorates your holiday home with jewel-like color. The faux red berry stem is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Faux Frosted White Berry Holiday Stem 45"
items.description_en: Our faux stem captures the magic and sparkle of ice-encrusted berries. Skillfully crafted to resemble this wintery spectacle, the stem showcases frosty, light-reflecting white berries that add wintery dazzle to your holiday decor.

items.name: Antique Green Verdigris Holiday Reindeers
items.description_en: Inspired by an ancient artifact that our design team spotted in a museum, our reindeer complements winter decor with a mix of whimsy and sculptural beauty. The large, lavishly antlered deer boasts a verdigris patina finish that gives it the unique color, subtle texture and charm of a flea market find. Pair with the smaller coordinating caribou—or multiples of each—to create a holiday herd on your mantel, entryway console or dining table.

items.name: Faux Cypress and Berry Leaf Holiday Bunch 19"
items.description_en: This festive bunch of faux botanicals heralds the holiday season with clusters of red berries, feathery cypress sprays, glossy holly leaves and juniper sprigs accented with blue-grey berries. For an easy accent, pop the bundle in a vase and place on the fireplace mantel, banquet or dining room table. Our cypress and berry leaf brunch is a Crate and Barrel exclusive.

items.name: City Hotel Holiday Advent Calendar
items.description_en: This delightful high-rise inn takes inspiration from the glorious historic hotels on Manhattan's Upper East Side. Each of the building's 24 windows doubles as a tiny drawer to create a three-dimensional advent calendar. Every drawer is marked with a silver number corresponding to the day of the month as it counts down the days to Christmas and reveals a daily treat or small gift (not included). Skilled artisans assemble pieces of laser-cut wood by hand to create the city hotel's graceful facade, dormer windows and steep snow-capped room, lovingly decorated for the holidays with a petite beribboned wreath and light-up garland.

items.name: Faux Red Berry Holiday Stem 39"
items.description_en: Ruby-red berries shine like jewels on this faux branch. Our red berry stem adorned with scarlet spheres adds vibrant color to arrangements of other wintry faux botanicals. Or create a more modern and minimalist look by placing a single stem in a tall clear or white vase.

items.name: Fern Green Fluted Marble Holiday Tree, Large 12"
items.description_en: Our sculptural tree upgrades a holiday icon in stunning green marble. Undeniably luxe with a hint of glam, the streamlined evergreen shows off the stone's deep hues and fascinating veining. Skilled artisans turn and carve the fluted, conical conifer by hand, buffing it to a beautiful finish. The tree makes a timeless addition to your coffee table, mantel or dining table centerpiece throughout the winter.

items.name: Faux White Pine Holiday Branch 48"
items.description_en: This delightfully realistic branch replicates the soft, fluffy needles of white pine. Pop one into a vase or mix it in with a holiday bouquet. Made with bendable wire, the stem can be shaped to look even more like the real thing.

items.name: Monroe Paper Mache Pumpkins
items.description_en: Our Monroe collection transforms scrap fabric into a patch's worth of paper-mache pumpkins. Skilled artisans press fabric pulp into a charmingly organic shape, which is then painted by hand with a matte finish in warm, earthy brown. Lightweight and highly textured, the small pumpkin layers with our other exclusive squashes and gourds to set an autumnal mood throughout the Halloween and Thanksgiving seasons.

items.name: Large 32" Holiday Wreath Storage Bag
items.description_en: This clever bag makes it easy to safely store, unpack and put away your faux wreath every year. Handsewn by skilled artisans, this tote is constructed of sturdy black fabric that resists water and abrasions. Hardshell walls protect your wreath, then collapse when empty for compact storage. Reinforced handles take the strain out of toting your large wreath back to the garage, attic, basement or closet once the holidays have come to a close.

items.name: Faux Norfolk Pine Holiday Stem 45"
items.description_en: Grace your holiday home with the expressive needle-like leaves of the Norfolk pine masterfully replicated in this faux stem. Pop in a vase or mix in with other botanicals to refresh your seasonal decor with lifelike greenery.

items.description_en: Our lifelike stem accents your home with the deep red color and succulent look of ripe apples. Looking ready for picking, the apples cluster on a graceful branch with green leaves. On its own, in multiples or integrated into botanical arrangements, the stem livens the home with its rich red color.

items.name: Faux White Mini Berry Holiday Stem 48"
items.description_en: Clusters of tiny white berries dot this delightfully realistic faux stem. Lovely popped in a clear glass or ceramic vase, the fool-the-eye branch decorates your holiday home with seasonal color. The faux white berry stem is a Crate & Barrel exclusive.

items.name: Faux Red Amaranthus Holiday Stem 50"
items.description_en: This faux amaranth stem updates the feathery plumes of the native Mexican plant for the holidays in festive red. The tall, lifelike botanical adds vibrant color and texture to faux and dried arrangements.

items.name: Faux White Berry Holiday Stem 39"
items.description_en: Delicate white berries dot branching stem of faux ilex. Lifelike accent piece brings nature's winter finery indoors.
